title: RN NYSNA
description:
Oneida Health Hospital is currently seeking a full-time Registered Nurse (RN) for its Ambulatory Surgery Unit (ASU). This is a 10 hour daytime position. This position not only specializes in preparing patients for surgery, but it also involves taking care of patients after they have completed their initial recovery from anesthesia; monitoring vital signs, managing pain, and watching for complications. This position reports to the Manager and/or Director of the Surgical Services Department. The ideal candidate will be able to work both independently and as part of a team while treating patients with kindness and consideration.

Key Responsibilities:

· Utilizing critical thinking, time management, and organizational skills in order to take care of adult and pediatric patients immediately after surgery ( Phase II ).

· Applying in-depth knowledge of patient safety and care when assessing patients pre and post-surgery

· Assessing and treating patients' pain immediately post-surgery ( Phase II) using different methods.

· Accurately document all pre-operative findings, lab results, and patient history in the EMR.

· Showcasing your superior communication skills as a team player

- Provide pre-operative care; initiating IVs, confirming NPO status, verifying/preparing the surgical site(s), ensuring all consent forms are correct, reviewing medications/allergies, and providing education to the patients/family members.

· Using keen observation skills to assess if possible immediate interventions / treatments are warranted (Pre and Phase II recovery).

· Remaining calm and professional in crisis and emergent situations

· Assuring patients that they are our number one priority and that their safety matters.

title: Arbetsterapeut till primärvårdsrehabiliteringen i Hagfors
description:
Vi söker en arbetsterapeut till arbetsterapimottagningen i Hagfors!

Din arbetsplats

Som arbetsterapeut jobbar du självständigt med patienter individuellt och i grupp och i nära samarbete med en kollega i Hagfors och en kollega i Sunne. På mottagningen i Hagfors jobbar även fysioterapeuter och vårdadministratör. Klimatet i gruppen är öppet och frågor bollas mellan nya och mer erfarna kollegor. Mottagningen ligger i anslutning till vårdcentralen och professionerna där.

Du kommer ges möjlighet att påverka din introduktion och erbjudas en mentor om du så önskar. Ledarskapet bygger på utvecklande ledarskap och tillitsbaserat ledarskap för att du som individ och organisationen ska kunna utvecklas på bästa sätt. Som medarbetare ger det dig större möjlighet till inflytande och mer frihet och ansvar i ditt arbete. Hos oss är det viktigt med hög tillgänglighet, god kvalitet och ett gott bemötande.

Primärvårdsrehabiliteringen norra har arbetsterapimottagning i Hagfors, Sunne, Munkfors och fysioterapimottagningar på alla vårdcentraler i norra Värmland. Inom hela primärvårdsrehabiliteringen jobbar totalt cirka 15 arbetsterapeuter på olika mottagningar i länet som regelbundet har nätverksträffar för att utbyta erfarenheter och utveckla verksamheten. För oss är värdegrund viktigt och vi jobbar tillsammans med andra verksamheter för att erbjuda bästa vården för patienterna.

Vi jobbar ständigt med förbättringar och fokus senaste tiden har varit digitalisering och tillgänglighet. Som arbetsgivare tycker vi att det är viktigt att ge dig möjlighet att utvecklas och trivas hos oss.

Vi är en hälsofrämjande arbetsplats vilket märks bland annat genom att vi schemalägger en timmes tid för egen fysisk aktivitet per vecka och erbjuder ett friskvårdsbidrag på 3000 kronor. För att läsa mer om våra förmåner klicka här Våra förmåner - Region Värmland.

Primärvårdsrehabiliteringen satsar även på kompetensutveckling för arbetsterapeuter genom att bland annat ha infört en karriärutvecklingsmodell. Med kompetensutvecklingsplanen som utgångspunkt planerar vi tillsammans din fortsatta karriär hos oss.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som arbetsterapeut hos oss jobbar du för att patienterna ska uppnå, eller bibehålla, bästa möjliga aktivitets- och funktionsförmåga, en ökad självständighet och en god hälsa. Du möter vårdsökande med varierade behov av undersökning, råd, bedömning och behandling.

Arbetet innefattar bland annat aktivitetsbedömningar, handrehabilitering, neurologisk rehabilitering samt kognitiv rehabilitering. Denna tjänst har placeringsort Hagfors men arbete på annan mottagning inom enheten kan vara aktuell, du reser du på arbetstid och med leasingbil. Då resor kan förekomma i tjänsten är B-körkort ett krav.

Dina kunskaper och kompetenser

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad arbetsterapeut. Erfarenhet inom primärvård är meriterande men inget krav och stor vikt kommer läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Hos oss är hög tillgänglighet, god kvalitet och ett gott bemötande viktigt. Som arbetsterapeut är du engagerad, ansvarstagande och strukturerar självständigt ditt arbete. Du är flexibel och ser möjligheter i förändringar. Med ett helhetsperspektiv fattar du beslut som bidrar till både patientens och verksamhetens bästa. Du samarbetar väl med andra, bygger goda relationer och kommunicerar tydligt med patienter, kollegor och samarbetspartners.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande så vänta inte med din ansökan. Välkommen med din ansökan redan nu!

Om Region Värmland

Vi är till för att alla som bor här ska må bra och för att vår region ska vara attraktiv och konkurrenskraftig. Vi gör skillnad inom hälso- och sjukvård, tandvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och kultur och bildning. Vi möter människor i livets största stunder och i alla de där vardagsögonblicken där emellan. Vår vision är livskvalitet i världsklass. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss och våra förmåner och följ oss på sociala medier.

Vill du också jobba för alla i Värmland? Välkommen med din ansökan.

Övrigt

Från 7 juni 2026 gäller EU:s lönetransparensdirektiv - för ökad öppenhet och rättvisa löner. Information om kollektivavtal finns på SKR:s webbplats, Kollektivavtal -SKR

I samband med eventuell anställning kan vi komma att be dig som sökande att lämna ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister. Inför anställning inom psykiatrisk vård, vård av funktionshindrade, vård av barn eller ungdomar gör arbetsgivaren en kontroll i polisens misstanke och belastningsregister. Ett utslag i detta register kan komma att påverka din möjlighet till anställning.

Har du skyddad identitet och vill göra en ansökan ber vi dig att kontakta Kompetensförsörjningsenhet HR via Regionens växel 010-831 50 00. Då får du hjälp att lämna in din ansökan utan att den hanteras i Varbi. Tänk på att endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Region Värmland tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

title: Product Manager
description:
Valsea - Where Innovation Meets Entertainment

At Valsea, we’re shaping the future of entertainment with immersive, engaging experiences that captivate players worldwide. Based in sunny Marbella, Spain, our vibrant open-space office is home to an international team of developers, marketers, product owners, and much more.

Valsea operates a leading scalable technology platform, 100% owned by us. This gives us the freedom to deliver results fast. We integrate selected outside companies into our ecosystem to ensure we provide fresh and vibrant products for our customers.

We work in a fast-paced environment, creating new brands, maintaining and improving our tech stack, launching leading acquisition and retention campaigns, and developing fresh features. Our ethos is simple - be best-in-class in everything we do.

Despite our rapid growth, Valsea still has that exciting start-up feel. We embrace a hybrid working model to balance professional growth with personal well-being. With a dynamic work environment, attractive salary, and a culture that thrives on collaboration, our power is our people.

We provide company laptops and other things you may need to work comfortably. Remote workers are always invited to our annual company trip and other team events. Ready to be part of something exciting?

What are we looking for now?

We're a multi-brand platform looking for a Product Manager whose north star is user engagement - how deeply and how often users interact with the product beyond their core transaction. You'll own the full incentives and retention stack across the portfolio: the mechanics that reward users, and the in-product experience that gets them to actually engage with those mechanics. This is a new role on the product team, with its own dedicated dev team to execute against your roadmap - you'll own everything that keeps users engaged, rewarded, and coming back.

What You'll do:

  • Define and own the roadmap for incentives, retention, and loyalty features across our multi-brand portfolio, with user engagement as the guiding metric for prioritization.

  • Partner with CRM/lifecycle marketing to translate campaign and segmentation needs into product requirements and platform capabilities.

  • Design and prioritize AB tests on incentive mechanics, offer structures, and retention flows.

  • Manage the economic modeling implications of promotional and reward mechanics.

  • Own the end-to-end wallet and bonus balance experience, ensuring redemption logic is transparent, compliant, and low-friction for users.

  • Own the in-product placement, visibility, and messaging of gamification and incentive features (missions, tournaments, VIP tiers, cashback, promotions) — treat feature discoverability and uptake as a core product metric, not an afterthought.

  • Partner with design to test UI placements, entry points, and promotional surfaces (banners, nudges, badges, wallet screens) that drive feature adoption.

  • Drive the roadmap for our Smartico CRM/gamification integration — from initial rollout across brands to ongoing feature adoption.

  • Define success metrics for retention and incentive initiatives (activation, redemption rates, LTV impact, churn reduction) and report against them.

  • Lead a dedicated dev team: write specs, prioritize the backlog, run sprint ceremonies, and unblock delivery.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with compliance/legal on regulatory constraints for promotional mechanics (jurisdiction-specific rules, usage limits).

  • Stay close to competitors and market trends in retention mechanics and loyalty design across consumer tech.

What You'll own:

  • Incentives engine - bonuses, promotional credits, cashback, rebates, and promotional mechanics across all brands, from rules configuration to user-facing UX.

  • Gamification & loyalty - missions, challenges, levels, VIP tiers, and reward mechanics that drive engagement and lifetime value.

  • User engagement - treat depth and frequency of interaction (sessions, feature usage, time in product) as a primary success metric, not a byproduct of other work.

  • Wallet - bonus balance logic, redemption requirements, conversion rules, and the user-facing wallet experience.

  • CRM integration - product ownership of our Smartico integration, ensuring campaign, segmentation, and gamification capabilities are fully leveraged and reliably wired into the platform..

  • New verticals (potential scope) - as we evaluate expansion into adjacent product lines, you may take on incentive and retention mechanics for that vertical.

  • Feature merchandising & UI placement - owning how incentive and gamification features are surfaced, positioned, and promoted across the product UI, so users actually discover and use them, not just that they exist.

What You'll bring:

  • 4+ years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to iGaming, gambling, fintech wallets, or loyalty/rewards products.

  • Direct experience with bonusing, cashback/rakeback, or gamification mechanics (bonus engines, wagering requirements, loyalty tiers).

  • A track record of driving measurable improvements in player/user engagement - not just shipping features, but growing how often and how deeply users interact with a product.

  • Experience working with or evaluating CRM/marketing automation platforms (Smartico, Optimove, or similar) from a product integration standpoint.

  • Strong analytical skills - comfortable defining KPIs, reading cohort/retention data, and using it to prioritize.

  • Experience managing a dedicated engineering team - writing specs, grooming backlogs, and owning delivery.

  • Understanding of AB testing methodology and how to collaborate with a testing-focused counterpart.

  • Excellent stakeholder management - you'll work across product, CRM, compliance, and games teams daily.

  • A strong eye for UI/UX and feature merchandising - proven ability to turn "the feature exists" into "players actually use it" through placement, visibility, and in-app promotion.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in sportsbook product, particularly bonusing/promotions for sports betting.

  • Familiarity with RTP and prize-pool economics.

  • Background in wallet or payments product work.

  • Multi-brand or multi-jurisdiction product experience.

How You will be measured:

  • Player engagement - session frequency, depth of feature interaction, and time spent across bonusing/gamification surfaces.

  • Bonus/promo engagement and redemption rates across brands.

title: Founding GTM
description:
Mello is building the AI-native control platform for complex enterprise spend.

Enterprises spend trillions on their supply chains and almost none of it is actually controlled. Contracts run hundreds of pages, invoices run hundreds of line items, and no system on the market can check the one against the other. So invoices get paid without anyone really looking, and 5 to 10% of that spend quietly leaks away.

Our AI agents read the invoices, enforce the contracts line by line, dispute what is wrong with the provider, and push clean cost data back into the systems finance already uses. We start with supply chain because it is the largest and most broken of these spend categories, and we grow across the rest as our customers pull us there.

Today we work with retailers, 3PLs and distributors across Europe.

We are venture-backed, still small, and you will see the whole company from the inside.

Aufgaben

You will work directly with the founding team and shape Mello's commercial engine from day one. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with real responsibility from the start - designed for someone who wants to learn how an early-stage AI company finds, wins, and scales its first customers from the inside out.

Rather than inheriting a polished sales motion, you will help build it: generating pipeline across every channel, carrying deals from first touch to close, and codifying what works into the playbooks and reporting that let the whole commercial team scale.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Outbound & Full-Cycle Ownership: Own the entire commercial cycle end-to-end - from first touch to closed deal. You'll drive the top of your own funnel across LinkedIn, cold calling, and email, running personalized multi-channel sequences against our ICP. From there you carry every opportunity the whole way through: qualifying prospects, running discovery and product demos, and driving deals to signature.
  • Playbook Building: Help build the "Mello Playbook" - turning your best-performing outreach angles, call scripts, demo flows, and objection-handling into structured, repeatable processes. Turning what works into a system, so success becomes repeatable rather than personal.
  • Reporting & RevOps: Help stand up our commercial reporting layer from the ground up. You'll define and track the metrics that matter (activity, conversion, pipeline velocity, win rates), keep our CRM clean and trustworthy, and turn raw activity data into a clear view of what's driving growth
  • Founder Support: Work directly with the founders on strategic commercial topics - from early customer feedback loops to GTM motion design - and act as a force multiplier as we scale toward repeatable revenue

Qualifikation

Mindset

  • You take full ownership and pride in execution
  • You enjoy solving a wide range of problems in fast-moving environments
  • You're curious about startups, AI, and how companies are built
  • You aspire to build something meaningful, potentially your own company one day

Experience

  • 1–2 years in generalist or high-agency environments (early-stage startups, consulting, venture, or operations)
  • Hands-on experience with automation tools (Claude, Lovable, Make, n8n, or similar) — or a strong drive to go deep on them fast
  • Strong intuition for software, data, and AI (technical background is a plus, not a must)
  • Comfortable working with incomplete information and figuring things out independently
  • High integrity, strong work ethic, and a strong sense of urgency
  • Clear and confident communication skills in German and English

Benefits

  • Attractive compensation with meaningful early equity upside
  • A high-ownership role with real responsibility and direct exposure to company-building
  • Close collaboration with the founding team in a small, fast-moving environment
  • Direct access to customers and the full loop from problem discovery to deployment
  • The opportunity to help build a product that redefines how logistics teams work

We move fast - end to end in ~2 weeks.

  1. Application review → every application is reviewed by the team
  2. Intro call → 30-minute conversation with a founder
  3. On-site → meet the team, work on a real problem together, and get a feel for how we operate
  4. Offer → clear decision and fast feedback

title: Hälsinglands tingsrätt söker tf.rådman, en eller flera
description:
2 plats(er).

Om Hälsinglands tingsrätt

Hälsinglands tingsrätt är en trevlig arbetsplats där arbetssättet präglas av ett nära samarbete mellan yrkesgrupperna inom domstolen. I organisationen bedrivs en kontinuerlig verksamhetsutveckling och vi arbetar tillsammans för att upprätthålla en rättssäker och effektiv rättskipning av hög kvalitet. Tingsrätten flyttade under våren 2023 in i nya ändamålsenliga lokaler i centrala Hudiksvall. Det är sammanlagt omkring 30 medarbetare vid domstolen. Hudiksvall ligger vid havet och erbjuder stora möjligheter till ett rikt friluftsliv med närhet till skog och fjäll. Det närmaste havsbadet ligger bara 10 minuter från stadskärnan. På vintern finns goda möjligheter till skidåkning. I Hälsingland finns flera slalombackar. Järvsöbacken och Hassela Ski Resort ligger inom domkretsen. I Hudiksvall är det korta avstånd och goda kommunikationer varför det är enkelt att resa till arbetet. Det är också bra kommunikationsmöjligheter med tåg eller bil till och från Hudiksvall. Mer information om tingsrätten finns här (https://www.domstol.se/halsinglands-tingsratt/).

Arbetet innebär

Som tf. rådman vid Hälsinglands tingsrätt handlägger du samtliga på tingsrätten förekommande mål- och ärendetyper. Att vara tf. rådman innebär att du utför ett kvalificerat juridiskt arbete, som är mycket intressant och omväxlande. Ingen dag är den andra lik och arbetet är fritt men även ansvarsfullt. Det finns goda möjlighet att själv planera och styra över sitt arbete samt att i viss utsträckning arbeta hemifrån.

Kvalifikationer m.m.

Du som söker ska ha erfarenhet från arbete som ledamot eller fiskal i överrätt eller under minst sex månader ha utfört en överrättsfiskals arbetsuppgifter. Eftersom anställningen löper under en kortare period är det meriterande om du har nyligen förvärvad erfarenhet från Sveriges Domstolar. Det är också meriterande att ha vana att arbeta med digitala systemstöd. Arbetet som tf. rådman ställer höga krav på juridisk skicklighet, omdöme, samarbetsförmåga, arbetskapacitet och självständighet. Du som söker ska motsvara de krav som ställs i Domarnämndens kravprofil (https://www.domstol.se/globalassets/filer/domstol/domarnamnden/kravprofil-for-ordinarie-domare.pdf) för ordinarie domare. För att bli aktuell för anställning krävs att du motsvarar högt ställda krav gällande omdöme, säkerhetsmedvetande och lämplighet. Vi ställer krav på att du står upp för laglydighet, demokratiska värderingar och den statliga värdegrund som styr Sveriges Domstolars verksamhet.

Övriga upplysningar

Tjänsterna är tidsbegränsade anställningar om 6 månader. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Skriftlig ansökan med meritförteckning och övriga handlingar som den sökande önskar åberopa ska ges in till Hälsinglands tingsrätt via rekryteringsverktyget.

Inför anställning kan det bli aktuellt med registerkontroller.

Hos oss tillämpar vi individuell och differentierad lönesättning. Vill du veta mer om hur vi arbetar med lön och se aktuella löneintervall för olika befattningar, kan du läsa mer på vår externa webbplats: Jobba hos oss – förmåner och villkor – lön (https://www.domstol.se/jobba-hos-oss/varfor-jobba-hos-oss/formaner-och-villkor/).

Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

Löneform: Månadslön. Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning. Varaktighet: 3-6 månader, tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.

title: (Senior) Quantitative Risk Analyst (Credit Risk)
company: Nordea Bank Abp Filial i Sverige
description:
Job ID: 6128

Would you like to take a central role in shaping Nordea’s credit risk modelling landscape and add real business value for Nordea? Then this opportunity is for you.

We are looking for a (Senior) Quantitative Risk Analyst to join our IRB modelling functions and drive the design, enhancement, and implementation of credit risk models across the organisation. The role combines advanced modelling, practical implementation of the models in our IT infrastructure and a sound understanding of banking. You need to enjoy working with large datasets, solve problems and find new and innovative solutions.

About our team

Meet the Risk Models Methodology & IRB models team. Our role is to develop and maintain models under IRB, and support other functions in the value chain . We strive to develop models that help business in their decisions and comply with relevant regulatory environment across multiple countries.

Our team adds value by accurately estimating the IRB risk parameters for Nordea’s customers. As the (Senior) Quantitative Risk Analyst you will play a valuable role in developing, maintaining and using models which accurately estimate Nordea customers’ credit risk and anchor these firmly in the business lines.

Given the nature of our data and regulatory requirements, we use advanced modelling techniques and big data technology. In addition to using leading techniques for modelling and data, the team’s role is general risk governance within credit risk modelling and methodology, including management of models, model implementation, data quality, documentation and model use.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

Main responsibilities in this role:

  • Develop technical tools that can be used for model development and other analysis, using tools such as Python.
  • Work on a subset of model lifecycle related activities like: data pipeline, data quality work, development, documentation, implementation, maintenance, monitoring, requirement setting, and user acceptance tests within credit and impairment models.
  • Contribute to methodological standards, modelling tools, coding practices, and continuous improvement of the modelling framework.
  • Drive projects within the IRB Models, and manage stakeholder relationships in the Risk, IT and Business organisations.
  • Present and justify analyses, results, and their implications to stakeholders, either through periodic activities or through ad-hoc requests.
  • Provide technical guidance, review the work of other modellers, and support setting modelling strategy and priorities.
  • Stay informed on regulatory developments and industry practices.

You’ll join an international team with a variety of backgrounds and skills. We work closely with other teams across the bank which provides you with excellent opportunities for personal and professional development. Our working language is English.

Who you are

This is the right role for you if you are:

  • Curious, enjoy learning and are excited about brining your ideas to the table.
  • Take ownership of the task but enjoy collaboration with others.
  • Confident in advanced quantitative modelling and eager to challenge ideas constructively.
  • Communicate complex statistical or methodological concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Enjoy working with large datasets and navigate well in tools used to analyse them.
  • Work well in a dynamic environment with varying workload.
  • Are keen to find solutions and not only raise concerns.
  • Able to think big picture but know that the devil is in the details. You are good at judging which details require extra attention.
  • Committed to deliver high-quality work.
  • Interested in coding and development of technical tools.

Your background and skills include:

  • A Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field, for instance economics, engineering, business, mathematics, science, statistics, finance, or similar.
  • Interest or hands-on experience working with data & modelling and conducting complex data analysis in financial services.
  • Previous experience with large volumes of data and programming. We use mainly Python / SQL.
  • Interest in understanding of regulatory requirements related to IRB, IFRS9 and stress testing and different modelling techniques.

Seniority of the role and remuneration will depend on the level of the candidate’s experience in the relevant fields.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 13/09/2026. For more information, you’re welcome to contact Matteus Arriaza-Hult, Head of Quantitative Methods & Projects at matteus.arriaza-hult@nordea.com.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

title: Organizational Change Management (OCM) Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Organizational Change Management (OCM) Lead based in Saudi Arabia.

This role will lead the people side of complex, technology-enabled business transformations, with a strong focus on SAP and large-scale ERP implementations.
You will shape change strategies that help organizations transition effectively to new processes, systems, and ways of working.
The position combines stakeholder engagement, communications, organizational readiness, training, and adoption measurement.
You will work across leadership teams, business stakeholders, project teams, and consulting partners to build alignment and momentum.
A key focus will be helping manufacturing organizations navigate transformation while minimizing disruption and maximizing adoption.
You will have significant ownership over OCM planning, execution, governance, and continuous monitoring throughout major initiatives.
This is an opportunity for an experienced change leader to make a measurable impact across complex, enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and implement comprehensive Organizational Change Management strategies aligned with transformation objectives, project timelines, and business outcomes.
  • Conduct stakeholder impact assessments, organizational readiness evaluations, and change impact analyses to identify affected groups, risks, and adoption requirements.
  • Establish and manage change networks, champion programs, and stakeholder engagement structures that support sustained adoption.
  • Design and execute communication strategies, including executive toolkits, targeted messaging, leadership communications, and employee engagement materials.
  • Facilitate leadership alignment sessions, stakeholder workshops, and engagement activities across different organizational levels.
  • Define appropriate OCM governance frameworks, roles, processes, and decision-making structures for large-scale transformation programs.
  • Create or contribute to comprehensive training strategies that prepare employees for new systems, processes, and operating models.
  • Manage key change deliverables, including readiness assessments, management toolkits, communication materials, training plans, and adoption metrics.
  • Monitor change-related risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans throughout implementation.
  • Track adoption and organizational readiness metrics, using insights to adjust change strategies and improve transformation outcomes.
  • Collaborate effectively with client teams, consulting partners, complementary service providers, and other stakeholders to ensure coordinated delivery.

    • Strong knowledge of SAP platforms, with SAP S/4HANA experience strongly preferred, and an understanding of the related business processes and transformation impacts.
    • Demonstrated experience developing change communication strategies, stakeholder engagement plans, readiness assessments, and adoption measurement frameworks.

    • Experience leading more than four large-scale business change initiatives is preferred.
    • Experience leading or playing a significant role in more than three large-scale technology-enabled change initiatives is preferred.
    • Experience designing and executing OCM strategies for global organizations is advantageous.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to work on complex SAP and ERP transformation initiatives.

title: Head of Project Management
description:
Join ICOMAT – Revolutionising the Future of Lightweight Manufacturing!

iCOMAT is an advanced manufacturing company that invented Rapid Tow Shearing (RTS) - the only proven technology for producing defect-free curved-fiber composite parts at industrial scale. We deliver the lightest structures possible for aerospace, automotive, defense, and space, at a rate and cost efficiency that far exceeds existing composite production processes.

We build and operate automated factories for composite materials, delivering components to Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs. The business has three main divisions: development of automated production machines, development of software design and production tools, and operation of the factory. We work with 25+ customers and completed the largest-ever Series A in composites manufacturing to fuel a significant scale-up, with growth plans that will see the business multiply in size over the next two to three years and expand operations into the UK, Europe and the US.

The business has currently more than 130,000 sqm of production capacity with manufacturing facilities in the UK (Gloucester and Swindon) and the US (Dayton, Ohio); a Hardware R&D Centre in Bristol, UK; and a Software R&D Centre in Athens, Greece.

As Head of Project Management you will own how iCOMAT delivers. Every customer production programme, from contract award through industrialisation and first article to full rate production, runs through your function. You will also build that function from the ground up: the processes, the tools, the reporting rhythm and the team of project managers behind it. Today we deliver components to more than 25 customers from a single UK factory. Over the next 2-3 years that becomes multi-site production across UK, US and Europe. The role is based at Factory 1 in Gloucester and reports to the Director of Global Manufacturing Operations.


What will you be doing?

  • Customer Programme Delivery

Owning delivery of customer production programmes end to end, from contract award through industrialisation and first article to full rate production. You will hold the schedule, the budget and the deliverables, and you will be the one accountable when a milestone is at risk. These are leading OEMs and Tier 1s in aerospace, automotive and space, buying parts that have never been made this way before.

  • Building the Project Management Function

Designing and standing up the project management function at iCOMAT: the governance, gate reviews, templates, planning tools and reporting cadence that let us run many programmes at once without dropping any of them. You will hire, lead and develop a team of project managers as we scale, and set the standard for how they work.

  • Planning, Risk & Reporting

Building and maintaining integrated programme plans with real critical paths, resource loading and dependencies. You will run risk and issue management properly: identify early, quantify, mitigate, escalate. Reporting to internal leadership and to the customer is concise, honest and on time, and always paired with the corrective action.

  • Supply Chain & BOM Management

Owning bills of materials and working with Purchasing and Supply Chain to secure long-lead items, qualify sources and keep material flowing to plan. You will make sure supply chain risk is visible in the programme plan long before it becomes a schedule problem.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership

Driving Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality and Supply Chain to a single plan. You will chair the programme reviews, resolve the trade-offs, unblock the team and make the calls that keep parts moving. Influence matters more than authority here, and you will need plenty of it.

  • Commercial & Customer Interface

Acting as the primary delivery contact for customers on progress, risk, change and recovery. You will support the commercial team in forming highly competitive proposals that are also deliverable, with realistic schedules and costs, and manage contract change so scope creep gets priced rather than absorbed.

What do we need from you?

  • Hands-on project management of manufacturing programmes is the number one requirement: you have delivered physical hardware to customer schedules, through industrialisation and into production

  • Aerospace, automotive or space experience is essential: 8+ years in project or programme management, with at least 3 years leading a team

  • A track record of running multiple complex programmes simultaneously without losing control of any of them

  • Experience building or significantly improving a project management function: process, governance, tooling and reporting

  • Relevant engineering qualifications are appreciated, but we value practical hands-on technical project management skills just as highly

  • Exceptional Office 365 skills, particularly Project, Excel and PowerPoint

  • Strong commercial awareness across contracts, change control, cost and margin

  • Supply chain and BOM management experience

  • Exceptional attention to detail, and the credibility to hold senior stakeholders to a plan

  • Proactive and resilient mindset with a “can do” attitude

Nice to have

  • Composites manufacturing experience

  • A track record of successfully managing Innovate UK, ATI or ESA grant-funded projects

  • Formal project management certification (APM, PMP or PRINCE2)

  • Experience taking a programme from prototype through to rate production in a fast-growing business

  • Exposure to AS9100 and OEM customer-specific programme requirements

Working conditions

  • Manufacturing and office environment, based at Factory 1 in Gloucester

  • Regular travel to customers, suppliers and our Bristol and Athens sites

  • Occasional international travel as we expand operations into Europe and the US

  • Flexibility to work extended hours when a programme milestone needs it

Our Values: Uncompromising Excellence

  • Discipline over excuses. We commit. We follow through. We hold ourselves and each other to the highest standard, especially when the pressure is on.

  • Push the edge. iCOMAT was built on a refusal to accept that curved fiber could not be manufactured at scale. We innovate where others hesitate.

  • Aligned and accountable. Everyone owns their lane, communicates openly, and delivers without being chased. No silos. No ambiguity.

Why iCOMAT?

  • Competitive Salary & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including private healthcare, pension scheme.

  • Stock Options: Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success

  • Career Growth Opportunities: Join us at a pivotal time as we scale up, offering unmatched professional growth opportunities in the rapidly advancing field of composite materials.

  • Innovation-Focused Culture: We pride ourselves on our inclusive, forward-thinking work environment. Recognized by Bloomberg as a "UK Startup to Watch," iCOMAT celebrates diversity and encourages all applicants, regardless of background, to apply.

  • Global Impact: Be a part of our mission to redefine lightweight structures for the automotive, aerospace, and space industries, working with some of the most influential companies worldwide.Ready to be part of something big?

Apply now to learn more and join us on our exciting journey!

title: Ny butik i Täby Centrum
description:
Grymt Godis Ballonger & Party driver idag två enorma godis, ballong och partybutiker i Stockholm och en tredje butik i Västerås. Snart öppnar vi även en fjärde butik i Täby Centrum!

Butikernas specialitet är försäljning av godis i lösvikt med ca 1200 olika sorter att välja på, samt 1000-tals heliumballonger och partyartiklar till fest och kalas.

Då vi snart öppnar en ny butik i Täby C behöver vi bli fler. För att kunna sätta sig in i jobbet och våra rutiner, söker vi redan nu två glada och arbetsvilliga personer som kan börja arbeta i någon av våra andra butiker. Detta för att vara redo innan vi öppnar butiken i Täby C.

"Rätt person" som vill kombinera jobbet i Täby C med arbetspass i våra andra butiker i Stockholm kommer att erbjudas en heltidstjänst.


Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete i butik (ej PRAO, sommarjobb eller praktik) i Sverige är ett absolut krav!

För att passa in i vårt glada gäng är det bra om du kan jobba i ett högt tempo, både ensam och med en kollega. Du är givetvis en punktlig, noggrann och ansvarstagande person, som vill bidra med engagemang och ett glatt humör. Vårt enda krav är att du ska ha minst ett års erfarenhet av butiksarbete i Sverige. Erfarenhet av arbete med heliumballonger är meriterande.


Butiksrutiner kan du redan, resten lär vi dig.

Gällande arbetssysslorna, så är det allra viktigaste att du har en positiv inställning och viljan att lära dig något nytt. Det du inte redan kan om godis, ballonger och party lär vi dig. Som person är du handlingskraftig, noggrann och ansvarstagande.


Är du den vi hoppas på?

Så fort du "känner dig som hemma" med oss och om vi alla trivs med varandra, så kommer du tilldelas mer ansvar och med det kommer också en rättvis löneutveckling.


Vad erbjuder vi?

Det du inte redan kan lär vi ut på plats i butiken, där vi tillsammans går igenom alla rutiner, moment och arbetsuppgifter.

Vi vet att våra medarbetare är det viktigaste för vår framgång. Därför är vi måna om att stödja och uppmuntra vår personal i deras arbete och erbjuder alla som arbetar hos oss goda utvecklingsmöjligheter.

Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Då butiken är öppen alla dagar i veckan förekommer dags-, kvälls- och helgarbete.


Har vi väckt ditt intresse?

Vi hoppas det! Vi kallar fortlöpande till intervjuer så skicka in CV och personligt brev i PDF-format redan i dag. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar som inkommer via e-post till: jonas@jeasgroup.se och skriv "Täby" i ämnesfältet, så vi vet att du läst hela annonsen

Vi tar oss friheten att inte besvara ansökningar som inte motsvarar platsannonsens kriterier

Vi undanber oss även all hjälp och/eller reklam från alla typer av rekryteringsbolag, jobbpooler eller liknande. Detta sköter vi bäst själva :)

title: Bilförsäljare till Karmauto i Göteborg
description:
Bilförsäljare Karmauto Karmauto är en personlig bilhandlare som är auktoriserad återförsäljare av Mazda och Hyundai. Deras fullserviceanläggning är belägen centralt i Göteborg och nås enkelt via stadens olika kommunikationer. På företaget arbetar idag ca 16 personer med att tillgodose kundernas behov och ge bästa service. Älskar du bilar och har jobbat med bilförsäljning sedan tidigare? Brinner du för att skapa fantastiska kundupplevelser? Då kan du vara den person vi söker till vårt trevliga kundföretag Karmauto i Göteborg. Hos Karmauto blir du en nyckelperson, där varje dag är varierad och full av möjligheter. Du tar emot kunder med energi och kunskap, lyssnar på deras behov och hjälper dem hitta rätt bil, tillval och finansieringslösning. Provkörningar och rådgivning där professionella affärsavslut och kunduppföljning blir en del av din vardag - alltid med fokus på att bygga långsiktiga relationer. Försäljningsteamet består av fyra personer och man hjälper varandra för att uppnå företagets och de individuella målen. Vidare hanterar du även administrativa uppgifter som avtal, registrering och leverans och håller dig uppdaterad om våra nya och begagnade bilmodeller och deras tekniska specifikationer och funktionalitet. Tillsammans med företagets serviceavdelning, finansbolag och kollegor säkerställer du en smidig och positiv kundresa. Vi söker dig som har minst 3-5 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av bilförsäljning och det är meriterande med tidigare erfarenhet av nybilsförsäljning. Du som söker skall tycka om att arbeta proaktivt och ha erfarenhet av egen uppsökande försäljning utöver de kunder som kommer till bilhallen. B-körkort är ett krav, och erfarenhet av CRM-system och digitala försäljningsverktyg är mycket meriterande. Personliga egenskaper som vi letar efter är:
  • Resultatorienterad
  • Driven och självgående
  • Förmåga att bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer
  • Engagemang och professionalism i varje möte med kund
  • Arbetar proaktivt
  • Trivs i en dynamisk miljö och målstyrd miljö
  • Noggrann och strukturerad
  • Förstår vikten av god administrativ ordning
Hos oss får du en dynamisk arbetsmiljö där du utvecklas, påverkar och arbetar tillsammans med ett team som brinner för både bilar och kunder. Välkommen med din ansökan, vi arbetar med löpande urval så skicka gärna in din ansökan snarast.

title: Dispatcher FT Days Peoria
description:
Join Team AMT! Now hiring for a Full-time Day shift Dispatch in our Peoria Communications Center!

Advanced Medical Transport (AMT) is the premier provider of emergency and scheduled ambulance services in Central and Western Illinois, as well as parts of Iowa. AMT is a private, not-for-profit organization operated for community benefit.

As a night dispatcher, you will be responsible for receiving requests for ambulance and wheelchair service, inputting information into the CAD System, selecting and dispatching the appropriate units to respond to the type of call and maintaining correct system status control.

This position will work a 12-hour shift rotation with three (3) 12-hour shifts one week and four (4) 12-hour shifts the second week, once training has been completed. While in training, you will work 8-hour shifts Monday through Friday.

What You Will Do:

  • Receive incoming emergency and non-emergency requests for service
  • Determine call the urgency and location of the situation
  • Dispatches the appropriate unit to respond to emergency and nonemergency requests for ambulance service based on the type of call and scheduled time
  • Maintain patient confidentiality
  • Relocate, as required, units from one post location to another as designated by the System Status Plan
  • Prepare accurate and timely statistical reports and appropriate paperwork
  • Follow operations service center policies and procedures

title: Operatörer till Nyköping/Tystberga
description:
Om bolaget

Mer information om företaget ges vid intervjutillfället

Vad vi erbjuder

Vi erbjuder dig en varierande vardag där du tillsammans med ditt team arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Du har en närvarande arbetsledare och kommer få en ordentlig introduktion. Tjänsten startar den 11 augusti och du blir anställd av oss på 2Complete där uppdraget sträcker sig i minst ett år med god möjlighet till förlängning. Vi erbjuder dig bland annat:

  • Kollektivavtal
  • Marknadsmässig lön

  • Engagerad arbetsgivare

title: Constructiebankwerker
description:
Als Constructiebankwerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor het maken van hoogwaardige onderdelen en constructies voor projecten binnen zware voertuigen en mobiele machines, van prototype tot kleine serie. Op basis van technische tekeningen bepaal jij zelfstandig de juiste aanpak en zorg je dat het eindresultaat voldoet aan de gestelde toleranties en kwaliteitseisen.

Je maakt deel uit van een gemotiveerd team dat resultaatgericht en met oog voor detail samenwerkt. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en je vakkennis in te zetten, met collega's om op terug te vallen waar nodig. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat elk product klopt, van maatvoering tot lasnaad. Naast constructies voor onze eigen projecten vervaardig je ook deelproducten in opdracht van klanten, waarbij precisie en betrouwbaarheid net zo belangrijk zijn.

Je werkt in onze eigen, moderne werkplaats, uitgerust met onder meer een 5-assige Abrasive Water Jet, CAM-gestuurde kantbank en diverse lastechnieken.

Als Constructiebankwerker:

- lees en interpreteer je technische tekeningen zelfstandig;
- meet, teken en zaag je materiaal nauwkeurig af;
- pas je verspanende technieken toe zoals boren, tappen, draaien en frezen;
- vervaardig je constructies en onderdelen op maat volgens de gestelde eisen en normen;
- las je onderdelen samen tot een compleet, functioneel geheel;
- vervaardig je deelproducten voor onze klanten, volgens hun specificaties en eisen;
- help je waar nodig mee bij montage en assemblage, tot het product afgerond is;
- werk je met ons moderne machinepark;
- controleer je jouw eigen werk op maatvoering en kwaliteit;
- signaleer je verbeterkansen in werkmethode of proces;
- werk je nauw samen met engineers en collega's binnen het team;
- denk je actief mee over de meest efficiënte en degelijke aanpak.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij MST Groep geloven we in vakmanschap, vrijheid en vertrouwen. Jij bent de expert op de werkvloer en krijgt de ruimte om dat vak zelfstandig uit te oefenen, binnen een team waar op elkaar gebouwd kan worden.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

- Een salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring en vakmanschap;
- 25 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen (op fulltime basis);
- Pensioenopbouw via MST Groep;
- Een eigen, modern ingerichte werkplaats waar je dagelijks zelf mee werkt;
- Reiskostenvergoeding;
- Een hecht, gedreven team waar vakmanschap gewaardeerd wordt.

Wie zijn wij?

MST Groep is een consulterend ingenieursbureau gevestigd in Nederland en Roemenië. Wij richten ons op mobiliteitsoplossingen van vandaag en morgen binnen onze kernmarkten zware voertuigen en mobiele machines. We streven naar mobiliteit die steeds autonomer, veiliger en duurzamer wordt.

MST Manufacturing vertaalt innovatieve ideeën naar concrete, werkende producten. Wij zijn de maakpartner voor organisaties die snelheid, precisie en betrouwbaarheid eisen, van prototype tot kleine serie. Dankzij onze mechanische en mechatronische productiefaciliteit, gekoppeld aan onze technische expertise, bouwen wij niet alleen wat nodig is, maar denken we ook mee in de optimalisatie. Onze kernwaarden: kennis, daadkracht, eigenaarschap, onafhankelijkheid en autoriteit, vormen daarbij de basis van hoe we werken.

Wat breng je mee?

- Een afgeronde technische opleiding op MBO-niveau, richting constructiebankwerken, plaat- en constructiebewerking of vergelijkbaar;
- Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring als constructiebankwerker;
- Ervaring met lassen (MIG/MAG en/of TIG) en verspanende technieken;
- Je kunt zelfstandig technische tekeningen lezen en uitvoeren;
- Je werkt nauwkeurig, zelfstandig en neemt eigenaarschap over je werk;
- Je bent een teamplayer met een proactieve, gemotiveerde instelling;
- Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

Klinkt dit als jouw volgende stap?

Solliciteer direct via de button, dan nemen wij snel contact met je op. Heb je eerst nog vragen over de vacature? Neem gerust contact op via +31 (0)118 227 430 of mail naar recruitment@mstgroep.nl.

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
Company description:

Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.

Since 1927, we have been a brand known for our commitment to safety, creating innovative cars that make life less complicated for our consumers. In 2010, we decided to transform our business, resulting in a totally new generation of cars and technologies, as well as steady growth and record sales. Today, we’re expanding our global footprint in Europe, China and the US, and we’re on the lookout for new talent.

We are constantly pushing our own skills and abilities to drive change in the automobile industry like never before. We are looking for innovative, committed people to join us in this endeavour and create safe, sustainable and connected cars. We believe in the power of people and will challenge and support you to reach your full potential. Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.

Job description: Let's introduce ourselves

Cyber Defense Centre Operations protects the business through 24/7 cyber defence capabilities, including security monitoring, incident response, threat intelligence, threat hunting, and digital forensics. We also own and continuously enhance strategic security platforms and services, including SIEM, SOAR, endpoint protection, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP), to strengthen the organization's cyber resilience.

What you'll do

Responsible for investigating cyber threats, security incidents, and critical vulnerabilities, while coordinating response activities across stakeholders.

The role leverages cyber threat intelligence to assess risks, support threat hunting, and drive timely containment and remediation to strengthen the organization's security posture.

What you'll bring

You would carry a Bachelor’s degree in Cyber Security, Information Security, Computer Science, or related field. You should bring 3+ years of experience in Security Operations (SOC), Incident Response, Threat Hunting, or Threat Intelligence. You should also bring experience coordinating and managing cyber security incidents.

Some technical competencies you should bring would be a strong understanding of cyber threats, attack techniques, and vulnerability management. Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, and security monitoring platforms as well a knowledge of cyber threat intelligence frameworks and methodologies (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK, Kill Chain). You should also bring experience investigating security incidents, malware, phishing, and advanced threats.

You would bring understanding of network, endpoint, cloud, and identity security technologies. You have a strong analytical and investigative mindset. You should have the ability to coordinate incident response across multiple stakeholders as well as excellent communication and reporting skills. You are capable to prioritize and manage multiple security events simultaneously and have a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating cyber risks.

Preferred Certifications:

GIAC (GCIH, GCFA, GCTI), CISSP, Security+, CySA+, or equivalent certifications.

  • God förståelse för livsmedelshygien och säkerhetsstandarder

Din ansökan kan komma att delas med våra systerbolag om din profil matchar en annan tjänst inom Team Olivia. Urval kan ske löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Tveka därför inte att skicka in din ansökan idag!

Vid eventuell anställning För anställning hos oss på Nordström Assistans behöver du ha ett BankID och godkänner att använda ditt BankID i tjänsten. En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling samt giltigt personbevis och/eller eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete i Sverige. Personbevis kan du enkelt ladda ned på Skatteverkets hemsida. På grund av att tjänsten kan omfatta ensamarbete, nattarbete och arbetsuppgifter som enligt Arbetsmiljöverkets föreskrifter (AFS 2012:3) inte får utföras av minderåriga, måste du ha fyllt 18 år för att få arbeta som personlig assistent hos oss. För dig med anställningsstöd Nordström Assistans är ett inkluderande företag. Vi välkomnar alla sökanden och även du som har rätt till någon form av anställningsstöd genom arbetsförmedlingen. Det är frivilligt att ange denna information i din ansökan, alternativt kan du även meddela detta vid en eventuell intervju.

Nordström Assistans Vi på Nordström Assistans är övertygade att med rätt hjälp och förutsättningar kan man nå mer. Vi vill förändra, förbättra och skapa vägen till en bättre tillvaro. Vi har funnits sedan 1998 och erbjuder idag personlig assistans i hela Sverige och utgår från regionalkontoren i Stockholm, Malmö, Jönköping och Gällivare. Vår framgång vilar på våra medarbetare och vi söker dig som vill vara en del av vårt team!

Vi följer kollektivavtal mellan Kommunal/Vårdföretagarna.

Du hittar mer information på https://www.nordstromassistans.se

title: Assistant/Associate/Professor of Law – Remote
description:
Assistant/Associate/Professor of Law – Remote

Online/Remote

Non-tenure track, Contract Faculty, J.D. Required

2 roles available

Salary $90,000 – 150,000, depending on experience


Vermont Law and Graduate School (VLGS), a national leader in environmental law and restorative justice, invites applications for two Assistant/Associate Professor non-tenure track, contract appointments to teach in the school’s growing Online Hybrid JD Program. Curricular needs include (1) Criminal Law/Evidence and (2) Business Associations/Tax. Appointments will begin in July 2027; the precise start date is flexible. title: Senior Product Designer
description:
About ENSEK

ENSEK builds the cloud-native SaaS software that's transforming how energy retailers operate, innovate and manage at scale. We help retailers lower operating costs, improve billing accuracy for consumers, and enhance customer experience through automation and AI-driven insight, all underpinned by modern, cloud-native architecture. ENSEK is at an exciting inflection point as we scale at pace towards new international horizons. If you're driven by solving complex, real-world problems and want to build modern technology that accelerates the global energy transition, you'll feel right at home with us.

About the role

As a Senior Product Designer at ENSEK, you will own end-to-end design across defined product areas within our core B2B platform, shaping user journeys, workflows and experiences from discovery through delivery. Working closely with Product, Engineering and Data teams, you'll connect design decisions to product strategy, customer needs and business outcomes while helping to evolve our design system and maintain a high bar for design quality. You'll also support the growth of our design practice by mentoring others, contributing to team standards and leveraging AI tools to accelerate discovery, insight generation and solution development.

Key responsibilities

  • Own UX delivery across a defined product area, mapping journeys, structuring flows and designing cohesive end-to-end experiences.

  • Connect design decisions to product strategy, customer outcomes and measurable success metrics.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers and Data specialists to define, validate and deliver effective solutions.

  • Contribute to the evolution of the design system, influencing component architecture, consistency and scalability across the platform.

  • Partner with the Lead Designer to translate experience strategy into high-quality, implementation-ready designs.

  • Use AI tools to model solution scenarios, synthesise customer feedback and accelerate design discovery and iteration.

  • Contribute to both existing platform initiatives and new product development as ENSEK continues to scale.

Key outcomes

  • Improved usability, efficiency and adoption across key product areas.

  • High-quality, scalable user experiences aligned with ENSEK's product vision and customer needs.

  • Strong design system foundations that improve consistency and speed of delivery across teams.

  • Measurable user and business outcomes supported by clear success metrics and evidence-based design decisions.

  • Increased design maturity through mentoring, collaboration and the development of team standards.

  • Strong cross-functional partnerships that enable efficient and high-quality product delivery.

Experience required

  • Proven experience owning end-to-end product design across a complete product area, rather than individual features alone.

  • Strong ability to connect design decisions to product goals and clearly communicate trade-offs with Product and Engineering stakeholders.

  • Deep understanding of design systems, component architecture, design tokens and scalable platform design.

  • Excellent UI craft with a track record of producing polished, consistent and implementation-ready work.

  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate design workflows, explore concepts and synthesise insights.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence others, mentor designers and contribute to evolving design standards.

  • Experience working within B2B SaaS or enterprise software environments.

  • Experience within regulated, complex or data-intensive product domains is advantageous.

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, product-led environments with a strong focus on execution and delivery.

Company Benefits

  • 25 days' holiday + bank holidays

  • Option to buy or sell 5 extra annual leave days per year

  • Vitality Health Insurance, including private healthcare, virtual GP access, mental-health support and wellbeing perks

  • Pension with 5% matched contribution

  • Regular team-wide and company-wide events

  • 2 volunteering days per year to give back

  • Remote-first working environment with offices in London and Nottingham

title: 10% Butikkselger MATCH Sørlandssenteret
description:
MATCH Sørlandssenteret søker målrettet og serviceinnstilt Butikkselger 10%, er det deg?

Vi søker Butikkselger til 10% stilling!

Du:

  • Trives med å jobbe med mennesker, salg og service, og drives av å jobbe mot felles mål

  • Liker å ta ansvar og er pålitelig, fleksibel og møter arbeidshverdagen med godt humør

  • Motiveres av personlig service som gjør en forskjell for kunden

  • Har et øye for detaljer og en interesse for mote og tekstil

I tillegg til en sosial og trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kolleger, tilbyr vi:

  • God opplæring og tett oppfølging

  • En variert jobbhverdag

  • Karriere og utviklingsmuligheter, blant annet muligheten til å søke vår interne Butikklederskole

  • En jobb i et selskap der bærekraft er en integrert del av vår forretningsstrategi

  • Muligheten til å jobbe med kvalitetsprodukter i et dynamisk selskap som leverer solide resultater og er i stor vekst

Vi har spurt våre medarbeidere om hva det er som gjør at de trives i Match:

«Jeg har kjempe gode kolleger, et godt team, og det gir meg energi når kunden blir fornøyd og jeg har en god dialog med kunden. I tillegg får jeg masse energi når mine ansatte forteller at de gleder seg til å komme på jobb.» - Misala, Butikkleder

«Det er gøy å jobbe i Match fordi alle jobber sammen mot samme mål. Det målet er fornøyde kunder,» Elham, Butikkselger

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Har fullført og bestått videregående skole, relevant erfaring kan kompensere for manglende utdannelse

  • Har salgserfaring fra tilsvarende bransje, gjerne varehandel

Stillingen krever at du er fleksibel med tanke på arbeidstid, og at du kan jobbe på dag- og kveldstid i både ukedager og helger, i tillegg til i ferier.

Mangfold er en styrke, og vi ønsker oss medarbeidere med ulike livserfaringer og perspektiver. Vi oppfordrer alle kandidater med oppgitte kvalifikasjoner til å søke.

Søkere behandles og intervjuer avholdes fortløpende.

title: Ekstrahjelp ARK Kvadrat Sandnes
description:
ARK Kvadrat søker salgsglad ekstrahjelp!

Vi tilbyr en arbeidsplass med til tider høyt tempo og mange spennende mennesker. Sammen med kollegaene dine er du ARK sitt ansikt utad. Du vil ha en sentral rolle i å gjennomføre kampanjer og aktiviteter, og skape en inspirerende butikkopplevelse for ARK sine kunder!

Som ekstrahjelp har du varierende arbeidstid og må påregne å jobbe dag, kveld og helg ved behov. Vi kaller inn til intervju fortløpende og vi ser for oss oppstart snarest.

Du vil følge produktene fra de ankommer butikken, til du overlater dem i hendene til en fornøyd kunde. Det innebærer utpakking og prising av varer, sørge for at butikken til enhver tid er presentabel og innbydende, og ellers utføre de oppgaver som butikksjef delegerer til deg. Som person er du ansvarsfull og du bidrar aktivt til å skape et godt arbeidsmiljø.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Brenner for gode kunderelasjoner

  • Er ærlig og ansvarsbevisst

  • Har interesse for bøker

  • Har gode holdninger og godt humør

  • Er fleksibel og positiv

  • Er ryddig og strukturert

  • Er 18 år eller eldre

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt, kanskje har du en interesse eller egenskap som ikke kommer frem på din CV? ARK mener mangfold og inkludering er en styrke. Vi ønsker medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, livserfaring og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsing.

Vi vet du vil trives i en organisasjon som har tydelige mål og møter utfordringene med entusiasme og pågangsmot i en bransje i utvikling. ARK går nye veier samtidig som vi fremhever og forsterker vårt hovedfundament; nemlig bøkene. Vi tenker langsiktig og er ansvarsbevisste på vegne av fellesskapet og vi har omtanke for hverandre. Sammen har vi det gøy på veien mot målet!

Gir dette deg en god følelse? Send din CV og søknad i dag! Vi ser frem til å bli bedre kjent med deg.

title: Experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Application Specialist – Supply Chain
description:
Looking for a new challenge where you can truly influence how a global supply chain is enabled through systems? Ready to think bigger? We welcome your application today.

About the role

We’re now looking for an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Application Specialist within Supply Chain to strengthen the ERP & PLM applications team.

In this role, you will play a key part in developing and evolving a global ERP platform, where Microsoft Dynamics 365 and IFS are central components of a long-term digital transformation. This is an opportunity to work with business-critical solutions at scale and contribute to shaping the future of a global supply chain.

Your future team

You will join an ERP & PLM team responsible for some of the company’s most business-critical applications. The team supports a global organization and drives the full application lifecycle, from daily support to long-term development and upgrades.

The team works closely with colleagues across different regions to improve and further develop the ERP platform. The organization is continuously evolving its ERP landscape to support a fast-growing, global business, with an increasing focus on scalability, integration and modern platform capabilities.

Work tasks

You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects and developers to drive improvements, shape solution design and ensure that the systems support both current and future business needs.

The ERP platform is a global solution supporting several core business functions, including manufacturing, warehousing, order fulfillment, purchasing and finance.

  • Drive requirements analysis and translate business needs into scalable system solutions
  • Contribute to solution design, architectural decisions and configuration of ERP solutions with a focus on supply chain processes
  • Play an active role in ERP-related transformation and implementation initiatives
  • Lead discussions with stakeholders across functions and regions
  • Ensure end-to-end process consistency across the ERP landscape
  • Support and continuously improve the ERP platform

We are looking for

We are looking for a collaborative and proactive professional with the ability to navigate complex environments and build strong relationships across the organization.

You have several years of experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and are comfortable taking a leading role in discussions around processes, solutions and priorities.

  • Extensive experience in business-facing roles, either as a consultant or internally in a larger organization, with a proven ability to build trust and influence stakeholders
  • Experience contributing to or leading larger transformation initiatives
  • Strong ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
  • Solid understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes
  • Experience with frameworks such as the SCOR model and/or Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain processes

Over the coming years, the company will drive several major initiatives within supply chain and ERP, supporting a rapidly growing and increasingly complex global business.

This role gives you the opportunity to be part of that journey – contributing to how the future ERP and supply chain landscape is designed and implemented.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Systeemtherapeut bij Altrecht Jeugd
description:
Achter de hulpvraag van een kind of jongere zie jij het bredere verhaal. Je hebt oog voor de invloed van het gezin, de omgeving en de ontwikkeling. Juist daardoor maak jij het verschil. Bij Altrecht Jeugd krijg je de ruimte om jouw systemische expertise in te zetten binnen complexe behandeltrajecten. Je werkt samen met een betrokken multidisciplinair team waarin samenwerking, inhoudelijke verdieping en jouw ontwikkeling centraal staan.

Daarom kies je voor Altrecht Jeugd

  • Specialistische diagnostiek en behandeling van complexe kinder- en jeugdpsychiatrische problematiek, in nauwe samenwerking met netwerkpartners

  • Veel ruimte om jouw systemische expertise in te zetten binnen multidisciplinaire behandeltrajecten.

  • Werken volgens GIT-Jeugd, met wekelijkse intervisie en inhoudelijke verdieping.

  • Intensieve samenwerking met psychiaters, klinisch psychologen, gz-psychologen, vaktherapeuten en andere systeemtherapeuten.

  • Ruimte om mee te denken over zorgontwikkeling, innovatie en kwaliteitsverbetering.

  • Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen de specialistische ggz.

Wat ga je doen?

Als systeemtherapeut begeleid je kinderen, jongeren en hun gezinnen waarbij de context een essentieel onderdeel vormt van de behandeling. Verhoudingsgewijs zal je meer gezinnen met jongeren zien dan met jongere kinderen. Je kijkt verder dan de individuele hulpvraag en betrekt het gezin, het netwerk en andere belangrijke systemen actief bij het behandelproces.

Vanuit jouw systemische expertise lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan diagnostiek, behandeling en het opstellen van behandelplannen. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en met ouders, scholen en andere netwerkpartners om de best passende zorg te bieden.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Uitvoeren van systeemtherapeutische behandelingen met gezinnen, ouders en jeugdigen

  • Een inhoudelijke bijdrage leveren aan intakes, diagnostiek en behandelplannen.

  • Adviseren van collega's vanuit een systemisch perspectief.

  • Met teamgenoten samen interveniëren in crisissituaties in gezinnen.

  • Samenwerken met ouders, scholen, wijkteams en andere ketenpartners.

  • Deelnemen aan multidisciplinaire overleggen en intervisie.

  • Bijdragen aan deskundigheidsbevordering binnen het team.

  • Actief meedenken over innovatie en de verdere ontwikkeling van systeemtherapie binnen Altrecht Jeugd.

Wat hebben we jou te bieden?

Ontwikkeling staat bij Altrecht centraal. In de zorg die we bieden, in onze aanpak en in jouw carrière. Bij ons krijg je de kans om te groeien en impact te maken. Vanuit een inspirerende omgeving, met bevlogen collega’s.

Als grote organisatie met diverse (TopGGZ) specialismen en meerdere werklocaties in en rondom Utrecht, denken we graag met je mee. We kijken naar jou als persoon, je ambities, en je voorkeuren zoals behandelprogramma’s en woon-werkafstand. Samen vinden we de rol die het beste bij je past.

Daarnaast krijg je van ons:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.544,- tot € 5.901,- (FWG 60) op basis van 36 uur per week.

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% (volledige dertiende maand) en 8,33% vakantiegeld.

  • 166 vakantie uren en 35 levensfase-uren per jaar op basis van 36 uur per week. Wil je nog extra tijd voor jezelf? Dan kun je extra verlof bijkopen, tot een maximum van 36 uur, afhankelijk van de omvang van je dienstverband.

  • Een jaarlijks balansbudget. Je kunt het bedrag uit laten betalen, extra verlof kopen of het bedrag verhogen tot € 1.400,- als je het inzet voor een vrijetijdscursus.

  • Een pensioenregeling bij Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn, een collectieve inkomensverzekering bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en korting op aanvullende ziektekostenverzekering via IZZ of Zilveren Kruis.

  • Alflex. Ons meerkeuzesysteem voor extra arbeidsvoorwaarden. Hiermee kun je jouw salaris fiscaalvriendelijk inzetten voor bijvoorbeeld een fiets, een sportschoolabonnement of aanvullende reiskostenvergoeding.

  • De Altrecht Academie. Hier vind je een uitgebreid aanbod aan (online) scholingen voor de specialistische GGZ. En dankzij intervisie met je bevlogen collega´s groei je elke dag verder in je werk.

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent een enthousiaste en betrokken systeemtherapeut die energie krijgt van het werken met kinderen, jongeren en gezinnen met complexe psychiatrische problematiek. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen verschillende systemen, werkt verbindend en ziet samenwerking als de sleutel tot goede zorg.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Een afgeronde opleiding tot systeemtherapeut.

  • Registratie als systeemtherapeut en lidmaatschap van de NVRG.

  • Ervaring binnen de kinder- en jeugdpsychiatrie of een vergelijkbare specialistische ggz-setting, of een sterke affiniteit hiermee.

  • Ervaring met systeemdiagnostiek en systeembehandeling.

  • Een systemische en transdiagnostische blik.

  • Goede samenwerkingsvaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende belangen met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Een proactieve houding en de ambitie om bij te dragen aan innovatie en kwaliteitsverbetering.

  • Een reflectieve werkhouding en de bereidheid om feedback te geven én te ontvangen

  • Scholing in Verbindend Gezag of bereidheid om dit te gaan leren is een pré.

  • Ervaring met suïcidale cliënten is een pré.

  • We zoeken bij voorkeur iemand die vanuit de achtergrond orthopedagogiek/psychologie systeemtherapeut is geworden.

Wie zijn wij?

Altrecht Jeugd biedt specialistische diagnostiek en behandeling aan kinderen en jongeren tot 18 jaar met complexe psychiatrische problematiek. We behandelen onder andere stemmingsstoornissen, ADHD, autisme, trauma, persoonlijkheidsproblematiek en ernstige gedragsproblemen.

We werken volgens het GIT Jeugd-behandelmodel, waarin effectieve psychotherapie, samenwerking en reflectie centraal staan. Wekelijkse intervisie en multidisciplinair overleg zorgen ervoor dat je continu kunt blijven leren en ontwikkelen.

Ons team bestaat uit gz-psychologen, klinisch psychologen, psychiaters, systeemtherapeuten, vaktherapeuten, orthopedagogen en andere gespecialiseerde collega's. Samen werken we aan passende, innovatieve en herstelgerichte zorg voor kinderen, jongeren en hun gezinnen.

Enthousiast en nu?
Solliciteer eenvoudig via de onderstaande button! Wil je eerst meer weten? Stuur gerust een berichtje of bel met Helga Gijzenberg via 06-2600890 of mail naar h.gijzenberg@altrecht.nl.

We kijken ernaar uit om van je te horen!

Goed om te weten

  • Een dagdeel meelopen kan onderdeel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure. Zo leren wij elkaar beter kennen.

  • Acquisitie op basis van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

  • Solliciteer rechtstreeks via . Zo weten we zeker dat jouw sollicitatie goed bij ons binnenkomt.

title: Founder's Associate (m/f/d)
description:
We are a fast-growing European healthcare company operating at the intersection of medical cannabis, digital health, and regulated healthcare services. With a strong, profitable core business in Europe and a proven operational backbone, we are now building our UK platform — and we're looking for the right people to grow with us.

Our UK team is at an exciting early stage. That means real ownership, real impact, and the chance to shape how we work from day one.

Tasks

Launch plan & patient journey (primary focus)

  • Own how our end-to-end go-to-market plan for launch hangs together - how the digital platform works, what the patient journey looks like, and what milestones need to be hit
  • Keep the launch plan on track by working back from key milestones
  • Turn strategy into execution alongside both founders, coordinating across workstreams (technology partners, clinical operations, regulatory) to keep launch on track

Founder support & general operations

  • Work as a close partner to both founders — with real exposure to regulatory, commercial, and operational decision-making
  • Support recruitment for key clinic hires, including running first-round interviews
  • Support the office search and fit-out in Central London, and the pharmacy site search and fit-out outside London

Requirements

  • Proven experience spanning digital marketing/growth and general operating or founder-support roles (e.g. Chief of Staff, Founder's Associate, EIR, or a growth/ops hybrid)

  • A background in a regulated, DTC, or healthtech environment is a strong plus, given the advertising and compliance constraints specific to medical marketing
  • Discretion with sensitive data and a genuine service mindset towards employees and candidates
  • A self-starter who's energised by the blank page — you're not looking for a narrow, pre-defined job description
  • Based in or willing to relocate to London

Benefits

  • A genuine opportunity to build something from the ground up — not just fill a seat in an existing structure
  • Close collaboration with experienced, entrepreneurial founders and leadership
  • A dynamic, international team with a mission that matters
  • Competitive compensation and flexibility in how and where you work
  • Real ownership and autonomy from day one, with a clear path to grow with the company as the clinic scales
