• Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem• Har du skyddad identitet? Ring Partille kommuns växel, 031-792 10 00, och be att få prata med Rekryteringsenheten• Vi tar inte emot några personliga brev• Inför anställning behöver du kunna styrka din identitet och, vid behov, arbetstillstånd

title: Senior Project Manager – Global HR Transformation
description:
The client is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager consultant to lead a strategic HR transformation program focused on modernizing and strengthening global HR capabilities.

The program aims to standardize and streamline HR processes globally, transition toward strategic and scalable global solutions, and phase out legacy systems while ensuring continuity of critical HR services.

The Senior Project Manager will lead multiple interconnected workstreams, align business and technology stakeholders, manage dependencies, risks and priorities, and constructively challenge plans and deliverables to ensure quality, pace and productivity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate a complex HR transformation program across multiple workstreams, driving the transition from current systems and processes to the future-state landscape and agreed business outcomes.

  • Define and maintain the overall program roadmap, including priorities, key milestones, dependencies, timelines and delivery plans.

  • Provide clear direction to workstream leads, establish accountability, and constructively challenge plans, timelines and deliverables to ensure effective execution.

  • Proactively identify and manage cross-workstream dependencies, risks and blockers, facilitating timely decisions and resolution of issues.

  • Drive the move toward globally standardized and streamlined HR capabilities and processes, covering implementation, migration and retirement of legacy solutions.

  • Own the program’s Change Management and Communications strategy, ensuring effective stakeholder engagement, organizational readiness, communication and adoption.

  • Lead and support Change and Communications resources in executing the strategy, providing guidance and challenging approaches and outputs where necessary.

  • Ensure robust planning and coordination across data, integrations, testing, cutover, business continuity and transition into BAU operations.

  • Establish and maintain effective program governance, providing transparent reporting, insights and decision support to senior sponsors and steering stakeholders.

  • Foster strong collaboration across HR, IT, Enterprise Architecture, global functions, external vendors and other key stakeholders throughout the transformation.

Required Experience

  • Substantial experience in leading large-scale business and technology transformation programs.

  • Experience from at least two similar transformation programs involving enterprise system implementation, migration and/or decommissioning at scale.

  • Strong experience in both project and program management, including leading multiple workstreams.

  • Experience with process standardization, globalization or capability transformation within a complex organization.

  • Experience in developing and assessing business cases and translating business needs into clear scope, priorities and decisions.

  • Strong experience in developing and leading change management and communication strategies as part of large-scale transformation programs.

  • Experience with HR systems, particularly HRIS, together with a good understanding of HR processes, payroll, data and integrations.

  • Experience in change management, including stakeholder engagement, organizational readiness, adoption and transition.

  • Sufficient technical knowledge to engage with architects and specialists and constructively challenge them when required.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct line-management authority, using an empathetic leadership approach that balances structure, accountability and culture.

  • Ability to quickly understand complex environments, get up to speed and establish clarity and momentum.

  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written

Preferred Experience

Experience with global HR transformation, SAP SuccessFactors or comparable HR platforms, payroll and time management, complex integrations, legacy-system decommissioning and large international organizations is considered an advantage. It is a plus if you are fluent in Swedish.

Start Date: 2026-09-16

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer based in Germany.

This is a senior engineering opportunity within a fast-growing consumer AI platform serving students across multiple international markets.
You will play a key role in building and evolving products used by a rapidly expanding global user base.
The position combines full-stack development with technical leadership and ownership of mobile experiences.
You will work across modern web and mobile technologies, collaborating closely with engineering and product leadership.
As the first dedicated senior/staff-level mobile lead, you will have significant influence over the architecture, quality, and direction of the mobile application.
The environment is remote-first, collaborative, and highly autonomous, with a small engineering team where individual contributions have visible impact.
This role is ideal for an experienced full-stack engineer who enjoys hands-on development, technical ownership, and mentoring other engineers.

Accountabilities

  • Take senior-level ownership of full-stack product development across web and mobile applications.
  • Lead the technical direction and end-to-end development of the mobile application, working closely with engineering and product leadership.
  • Contribute to the development and evolution of React Native applications, including architecture, performance, reliability, and user experience.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable frontend and backend systems using TypeScript and the broader technology stack.
  • Develop modern web experiences using React.js, Next.js, HTML, CSS, and Tailwind.
  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js, Nest.js, Prisma, and AWS.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering stakeholders to translate product requirements into robust, maintainable technical solutions.
  • Establish and maintain high engineering standards, including code quality, testing, documentation, version control, and collaborative development practices.
  • Contribute to technical architecture decisions and continuously improve application performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Support automated and end-to-end testing practices, including Playwright where appropriate.
  • Mentor, guide, and support other engineers while helping raise the team's technical capabilities.
  • Lead and manage engineering initiatives, balancing hands-on development with technical leadership and team coordination.
  • Identify opportunities to improve development workflows, engineering processes, and the overall product development lifecycle.

    • Requirements

    • At least 5 years of professional experience as a Full-Stack Engineer.
    • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
    • Hands-on experience with Node.js, React.js, Next.js, Nest.js, Prisma, and Tailwind.
    • Experience developing and maintaining modern web applications and backend services.
    • Experience with React Native and mobile application development, with the ability to take ownership of mobile architecture and delivery.
    • Strong understanding of Git and collaborative software development workflows.
    • Experience leading or managing engineering teams, projects, or technical initiatives.
    • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including clean architecture, maintainable code, debugging, testing, and performance optimization.
    • Ability to work effectively across the frontend, backend, and mobile layers of a product.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with product and engineering leadership.
    • High degree of ownership, autonomy, and accountability in a remote working environment.
    • Experience writing end-to-end tests with Playwright is a plus.
    • Experience with Python is a plus.
    • Familiarity with Jotai, Zustand, Redux, or similar state-management solutions is a plus.
    • Experience with Expo and AWS is advantageous.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote opportunity within Europe, with a preference for candidates based in Western or continental Europe.
      • Full-time employment or independent contractor engagement options.
      • Flexible salary with no fixed compensation budget, allowing offers to reflect experience and seniority.
      • Stock options.
      • Opportunity to become the first dedicated senior/staff-level mobile engineering lead within the team.
      • Significant technical ownership over the mobile application and influence on product and engineering direction.
      • Opportunity to work with a modern technology stack including Node.js, React.js, React Native, Next.js, Nest.js, Expo, Prisma, Tailwind, and AWS.
      • Direct collaboration with engineering and product leadership in a small, high-impact team.
      • Remote-first environment with substantial autonomy and flexibility.

title: Däckskiftare till höstens högsäsong – Södra Stockholm
description:
Däckskiftare till höstens högsäsong – Södra Stockholm

Nu söker vi erfarna däckskiftare till höstens högsäsong i södra Stockholm. Här får du ett fysiskt jobb där dagarna går snabbt, du arbetar tillsammans med ett team och ser tydliga resultat av ditt arbete varje dag.

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha tidigare erfarenhet av däckskifte och vara van vid att arbeta praktiskt i ett högt tempo. Du är noggrann, arbetsvillig och trivs med att samarbeta med andra. Du får en introduktion på plats och kommer snabbt in i arbetssätt och rutiner.

Om rollen

Som däckskiftare blir du en viktig del av verkstadsteamet under höstens intensiva däckskiftarsäsong. Tillsammans ser ni till att kunderna får sina bilar redo för vintern snabbt, säkert och med kvalitet i varje moment.

Tempot kan stundtals vara högt, men det är också det som gör jobbet roligt. Du arbetar praktiskt, använder verktyg och samarbetar nära med dina kollegor genom hela arbetsdagen.

I rollen som däckskiftare kommer du bland annat att:

  • Ta emot bilar som kommer in i verkstaden

  • Skifta däck på personbilar

  • Tvätta och kontrollera däck

  • Använda verktyg som mutterdragare

  • Följa tydliga rutiner för att arbetet ska bli säkert och effektivt

  • Samarbeta med teamet för att hålla ett bra tempo genom dagen

Arbetstider: Måndag–fredag 08.00–17.00 Omfattning: Heltid Tillträde: Slutet av oktober Uppdragets längd: Cirka 6 veckor

Efter säsongen finns möjlighet till fortsatt arbete via Jobwise för dig som visar framfötterna och gör ett bra jobb.

Vi söker dig som

  • Har tidigare erfarenhet av däckskifte

  • Har B-körkort

  • Har tillgång till bil

  • Behärskar svenska i tal och skrift

  • Klarar av ett fysiskt arbete i högt tempo

  • Trivs med att arbeta i team

  • Är noggrann och ansvarstagande

Detta är även meriterande

  • Truckkort A+B

title: Lead 3D Environment Artist (m/f/d)
description:
Who we are

Sandbox Interactive is the ambitious game development studio behind the award-winning game Albion Online. The game is the first true cross-platform MMO, and is playable on Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS and Android with more than 350.000 daily players and over 2 million monthly visitors on our website. We started as a small independent group of experienced gaming professionals in 2012, and now employ an international team of more than 100 people. Since 2020, Sandbox Interactive has been part of the Stillfront Group. Our team is passionate about making Albion Online the best game it can be, and we’re constantly on the lookout for talented individuals to join our growing team in the heart of Berlin.

Your Game

We are looking for an experienced Lead 3D Environment Artist to lead our Environment Art team in creating immersive, stylized high-quality game worlds. In this role, you will combine artistic leadership with hands-on production, guiding the team to deliver visually compelling environments while ensuring assets meet technical requirements, production schedules, and the overall artistic vision of the game.

As the Lead 3D Environment Artist, you will collaborate closely with the Art Direction, Concept Art, Level Design, VFX and Technical Art, Game Design, Production and other disciplines to establish efficient workflows and deliver outstanding player experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the 3D Environment Art team, fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture

  • Drive the creation of stylized high-quality 3D assets and environments that align with the project's artistic vision and technical standards

  • Review and approve environment assets, ensuring consistency, quality, optimization, and successful in-game implementation

  • Collaborate with Art Direction, Feature Owner, Concept Art, Level Design, Game Design, Technical Art, and other disciplines to deliver engaging and narratively rich game environments

  • Establish and maintain efficient environment art workflows, pipelines, documentation, and best practices

  • Partner with Production to plan priorities, coordinate team deliverables, and ensure milestones are met

  • Identify production risks, resolve environment art issues, and continuously improve team processes and asset quality

  • Support the growth and development of the team through recruitment, onboarding, coaching, and performance feedback while promoting a culture of continuous learning

Your Talent

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in 3D environment art for games, including experience leading or mentoring artists

  • Strong portfolio showcasing stylized high-quality 3D environment assets, environment compositions, stylized textures and visual storytelling

  • Expertise with industry-standard 3D tools and modern game engines (e.g., Blender, Maya, Photoshop, Unreal Engine, Unity)

  • Deep understanding of 3D stylized modeling, environment visual composition and narrative, real-time asset implementations and stylized textures creation

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills

  • Ability to foster an inclusive, collaborative, and respectful team environment, with strong interpersonal skills, empathy, and cultural awareness

  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) in English

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience shipping successful MMO or live-service games

  • Experience leading or mentoring an art team and being responsible for an art production pipeline

  • Knowledge of 3D stylized modelling, visual narrative, level art or world building, real time game engines and tools such as Substance Designer or Photoshop.

  • Experience improving environment art pipelines and collaborating with Production, Level Design and Technical Art

Our Offer

  • BVG corporate ticket:

    • Receive a free company ticket for Germany's public transportation system

  • Personal Development:

    • Have a high degree of autonomy and ownership from the start

    • Develop your skills through company-sponsored training and language courses

    • Enjoy company-sponsored tickets for Gamescom Dev & other game conferences

  • Hybrid Work model:

    • Combine the best of both worlds, and enjoy the freedom to switch between working in the office and working remotely

  • Health & Wellbeing:

    • Discounted membership to Urban Sports Club for fitness and wellness

    • Access to nilo health for confidential mental health support, coaching, and wellbeing resources

    • Extra vacation days awarded based on years of service, up to a maximum of 30 days annually

  • Modern & Well-Equipped Office:

    • Work in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg, a central, vibrant neighborhood in Berlin with many dining and entertainment options

    • Enjoy height-adjustable tables, ergonomic chair options, dimmable lighting, and acoustic panels

  • Start-up perks:

    • Benefit from free drinks and snacks in the office

    • Participate in team events, breakfast weeks, summer and winter parties

  • Sustainable business:

    • Be part of a successful, profitable company on a continued growth path

  • Gaming-driven culture:

    • Work alongside a supportive team of gaming enthusiasts who are deeply committed to their craft

  • Global reach:

    • Join a team of industry experts shaping a game enjoyed by hundreds of thousands worldwide

title: Infrastructure Architect
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will help shape a future identity and access setup in a large, complex public-sector environment. The focus is on evaluating and designing how account provisioning and authentication should work between on-premises Active Directory and Google Workspace as part of a new AD structure. You will compare different technical approaches, explain trade-offs clearly, and recommend the solution that best fits the customer’s needs.

A key part of the role is to assess whether the current setup should continue with Google Cloud Directory Sync (GCDS), transition to Entra ID for account synchronization, or move toward another suitable approach. You will also evaluate the right federation solution for the future target state and outline how the transition should be handled during an account migration to a new Active Directory environment. This is a great opportunity if you enjoy solving complex identity architecture challenges and turning them into clear, actionable recommendations.

Job Description
  • You will design and document account provisioning flows between on-premises Active Directory and Google Workspace.
  • You will design and document authentication flows for the future identity setup.
  • You will evaluate whether the current synchronization approach should remain with GCDS, move to Entra ID, or follow another solution path.
  • You will assess federation options for a future-state architecture and explain the pros and cons of each alternative.
  • You will provide clear recommendations that support technical decision-making in a complex environment.
  • You will develop a practical plan for managing identity-related changes during migration to a new Active Directory structure.
Requirements
  • Expertise in Google Workspace
  • Expertise in Google Cloud Directory Sync (GCDS)
  • Experience with federation solutions
  • Experience with Entra ID
  • Professional fluency in Swedish and English
Nice to have
  • Good knowledge of Active Directory
  • Good knowledge of tiering models
What We Offer
  • Permanent employment at Avaron AB
  • Occupational pension
  • Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year
Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Audio Electronics Systems Engineer
description:
Mpya Sci & Tech was created by and for people who love technology and science. We’re not here to do what everyone else is doing. We believe that real talent lies in individuals who dare to keep growing throughout their entire lives. With extensive experience and deep industry knowledge, we’ve built a forward-leaning and cutting-edge company—our way. At Mpya Sci & Tech, we believe in a sustainable working life where we build a culture together based on genuine involvement, eager curiosity, and the freedom to be yourself. Learn more at: www.mpyascitech.com .

Är du en duktig elektronik-utvecklare med audio-kunskap? en "Jack of all trades" som är trött på långa beslutsvägar och tröga processer?Vill du arbeta varierat och med hela utvecklingskedjan? Javisst, det får du i detta uppdrag :)

På Mpya Sci & Tech kombinerar vi specialistkompetens med ett mänskligt och långsiktigt konsultliv. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i varierande uppdrag ute i industrin – utan att tappa tillhörigheten till ett team som förstår din vardag.

Vi tror på frihet under ansvar, nära ledarskap och att rätt människor gör störst skillnad när de får rätt förutsättningar. Därför lägger vi stor vikt vid att matcha uppdrag utifrån både kompetens och motivation.

Vi söker digEn Audio System Design Engineer som vill ta en central roll i ett R&D-team. Du kommer att vara med och definiera framtidens elektroniska lösningar inom vår kunds produktportfölj – från idé till färdig produkt. Det här är en roll för dig som inte bara designar – utan också strukturerar, förklarar och driver tekniska beslut framåt i ett högt tempo.

Om rollen

Som System Design Engineer ansvarar du för den övergripande systemdesignen i kundens produkter. Du säkerställer att lösningar är tekniskt robusta, kostnadseffektiva och möjliga att industrialisera.

En central del av rollen är att ta fram tydliga och strukturerade kravspecifikationer, både för internt utvecklingsarbete och för projekt där de outsourcar hela eller delar av utvecklingen. Du behöver kunna översätta behov till konkreta, genomarbetade underlag som andra kan arbeta effektivt utifrån.

Man arbetar med korta utvecklingscykler, vilket ställer krav på att du kan växla mellan analys och praktiskt arbete – och snabbt driva lösningar framåt.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden

  • Driva och utveckla nya systemlösningar och produktkoncept

  • Ta fram strukturerade kravspecifikationer och designunderlag för både intern utveckling och externa partners

  • Aktivt utvärdera och motivera tekniska val (t.ex. chipval, RF- och audiolösningar)

  • Snabbt testa idéer, iterera och driva förbättringar
  • Säkerställa att design uppfyller krav inom t.ex. EMC, RF och akustik
  • Ta fram teknisk dokumentation för produktion och leverantörer
  • Driva förändringar och förbättringar i befintliga produkter

Vi söker dig som…

  • Har en stark teknisk grund inom audio/elektronik och systemdesign
  • Har flera års erfarenhet av produktutveckling
  • Är van att skriva tydliga, strukturerade kravspecifikationer och tekniska underlag
  • Kan paketera komplex teknik så att både interna team och externa leverantörer kan arbeta effektivt utifrån den
  • Är hands-on och trivs i labbmiljö, där du testar, mäter och itererar lösningar
  • Arbetar snabbt och lösningsorienterat – och driver arbetet framåt även vid osäkerhet
  • Är trygg i att fatta tekniska beslut och kan förklara och motivera dem tydligt
  • Vågar ifrågasätta och förbättra befintliga lösningar på ett konstruktivt sätt
  • Är strukturerad och metodisk, även i ett högt tempo

Teknisk kompetens

Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:

  • Systemdesign och arkitektur inom embedded electronics
  • PCB-design är ett måste!
  • EMC-design
  • RF-design
  • Audio, akustik och audio processing
  • Programmering / testmiljöer (t.ex. LabVIEW eller liknande)

Kvalifikationer

  • Civilingenjör / högskoleingenjör inom elektronik eller motsvarande erfarenhet
  • Flera års erfarenhet av elektronikutveckling i produktutvecklingsmiljö
  • Flytande engelska i tal och skrift
  • Svenska är meriterande

Varför den här rollen är viktig

Vår kund vill stärka förmågan att fatta välgrundade tekniska beslut snabbt och tidigt i utvecklingsprocessen. Därför söker vi dig som kombinerar:

  • Struktur (specar, krav, tydlighet)
  • Praktisk förmåga (testa, labba, verifiera)
  • Tempo (korta iterationer och snabba beslut)

Om Mpya

På Mpya Sci & Tech tror vi på ett hållbart arbetsliv och bygger en kultur där du kan:

  • Be Dedicated
  • Be Brave and Curious
  • Be Inclusive and Allowing

Vi tror att verklig talang finns hos dem som vågar fortsätta utvecklas och växa genom hela livet. Med djup branschkunskap och lång erfarenhet har vi byggt ett framsynt bolag på vårt eget sätt.

Din ansökan

Är du driven och nyfiken på oss och våra kundsammarbeten? Hör gärna av dig! Kontakta Patrik Artman på 0733-908035 eller patrik.artman@mpyascitech.com. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Van Driver - Night Shift
description:
Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for a position in which you can keep things moving and deliver when it matters most? If so, then you could be the newest addition to our team as Van Driver.

If you think your personality, skills, experience, and desire match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Korttidsvikarier till nattarbete i hemtjänsten Uddevalla Kommun
description:

Välkommen att bli en del av vår växande kommun - och att tillsammans med oss arbeta för att ge våra kommuninvånare ännu bättre service.

Nattverksamheten består av flera team som tillsammans ansvarar för att ge våra brukare en trygg och säker omsorg. Det ställer krav på flexibilitet, god samarbetsförmåga och en vilja att snabbt sätta dig in i olika arbetsgrupper och områden. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och söker dig som har rätt känsla för omsorgsarbetet, visar omtanke och respekt samt bidrar till ett tryggt och professionellt bemötande i varje möte.

Läs gärna mer om våra verksamheter:

Vikarieportalen

  • Är flexibel och har lätt att anpassa dig till förändrade omständigheter

  • Vi prioriterar sökande med godkänd eller pågående utbildning motsvarande omvårdnadsprogrammet.

title: Tandlæge til Slagelse
description:
Til vores moderne klinik i Slagelse søger vi en erfaren tandlæge til en fast stilling på ca. 30 timer om ugen med opstart den 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest herefter.

Stillingen

Du får en spændende og varieret hverdag med en fuld patientbog og egne patienter. Du vil arbejde med alment tandlægearbejde, herunder undersøgelser, og har du kirurgisk erfaring, vil dette også udgøre en stor del af dit arbejde.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt og engageret team, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen og har stor fokus på faglig sparring og udvikling – både inden for og på tværs af faggrupper.

Klinikken

Klinikken er placeret centralt i Slagelse og har et stort, veletableret patientgrundlag.

Klinikken har 9 klinikrum samt OP og CBCT, og vi arbejder blandt andet med TRIOS-scanner og Dental Suite.

Vi tilbyder et bredt udvalg af behandlinger – fra almindelig forebyggende tandpleje til mere komplekse behandlinger som kroner, broer, kirurgi, implantater og snorkeskinner samt æstetiske behandlinger som Invisalign og tandblegning.

Du bliver en del af et team bestående af tandlæger, tandplejere, klinikassistenter, elever, en partnertandlæge, en juniorpartner og en klinikleder. Vi har en uformel arbejdskultur med et fladt hierarki, hvor vi respekterer hinandens forskelligheder og lægger vægt på et godt samarbejde. Vi sparrer meget med hinanden – også på tværs af faggrupper – og vægter både det faglige og sociale fællesskab højt.


Dig

Vi søger en erfaren tandlæge, som oprigtigt har lyst til at blive en del af vores klinik i Slagelse. Vi ser gerne, at du har minimum 3 års erfaring fra privat tandlægepraksis og meget gerne med kirurgisk erfaring.

Du sætter en ære i at være grundig samt informere og vejlede dine patienter, så de på et oplyst grundlag kan vælge den behandling, der er bedst for dem. Du har desuden erfaring med større behandlingsplanlægning og er motiveret for løbende faglig udvikling.

Du har en positiv attitude, som smitter af på dine omgivelser. Du møder både kolleger og patienter med et smil og bidrager aktivt til det gode fællesskab og til, at vi sammen når vores fælles mål.

Vi tilbyder

Du bliver en del af Europas største tandlægekæde med omkring 600 klinikker fordelt over 11 lande i Europa – heraf 25 i Danmark.

Vi gør os umage for ikke blot at levere gode behandlinger, men også at være et godt sted at arbejde.

Vi er derfor stolte over at vi for 5. år i træk netop er blevet certificeret i Great Place to Work.

Det er afgørende for vores succes, at vores klinikpersonale altid er opdateret på den nyeste viden og udvikling inden for faget. Derfor får du løbende mulighed for efter- og videreuddannelse. Vi har stort fokus på at give vores medarbejdere mulighed for at skabe den karriere, de drømmer om – eller bygge videre på den, de allerede har.

Ansøgning

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Klinikleder Kristina Mattebjerg på telefon 58531414 eller på mail kristina.mattebjerg@colosseumklinikken.dk.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, og lukker stillingen når den rette kandidat er fundet.

title: Νοσηλευτής/α

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Build, secure and support technology that operates in some of the world’s toughest environments.

VERIDAPT is looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team, based in Manila, Philippines.

This is a hybrid role, giving you the flexibility to work from home while still connecting with the team in person at company events.

Your role will be to keep AdaptIQ and VERIDAPT’s global IoT fleet secure, reliable and performing at its best. You’ll solve complex production challenges, strengthen our infrastructure and security, and help raise the technical capability of the wider engineering team.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who is comfortable operating across cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, networking, databases, security and IoT fleet operations rather than working within one narrow specialisation.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll take ownership across a broad technical environment, including:

  • Managing and evolving our cloud infrastructure across AWS and Vultr

  • Leading infrastructure migrations, including on-premise to SaaS and database upgrades

  • Owning production incidents end-to-end, including SaaS outages, connectivity issues and database incidents

  • Participating in the PagerDuty on-call rotation and contributing to post-incident reviews

  • Administering PostgreSQL environments, including replication, backups, migrations and performance tuning

  • Managing network and security infrastructure including OPNsense/MikroTik firewalls, WireGuard, Netbird and IPSec VPNs

  • Supporting vulnerability management, SIEM monitoring and security incident response

  • Provisioning, upgrading and troubleshooting IoT devices deployed at remote customer sites

  • Building and maintaining automation using Ansible and AWX

  • Improving monitoring and observability using tools such as Grafana, Graylog/VictoriaLogs, Zabbix and LogicMonitor

  • Running scheduled SaaS maintenance windows and working directly with customer IT teams

  • Reviewing peers’ work, improving runbooks and mentoring other engineers

The role spans cloud infrastructure, incident response, PostgreSQL, networking and security, IoT fleet operations, monitoring, automation and customer-facing technical work.

What we’re looking for

You’ll ideally bring:

  • 5+ years’ experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, Cloud Infrastructure or Systems Engineering

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure, networking and production environments

  • Advanced Linux systems administration capability

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code and automation experience, particularly Ansible/AWX

  • Strong PostgreSQL administration experience, including backups, replication, migrations and performance tuning

  • Solid networking knowledge across VPNs, firewalls, DNS, routing and IP networking

  • Experience with monitoring, logging and observability platforms

  • Demonstrated experience managing production incidents and troubleshooting complex systems

  • Practical cybersecurity, vulnerability management and security incident-response experience

  • Strong scripting capability, ideally Python, Bash or similar

  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to work directly with customers and mentor other engineers

Highly regarded

Experience or qualifications in any of the following would be advantageous:

  • Industrial IoT, mining, rail, energy or operational technology environments

  • AWS certifications

  • Red Hat / Linux certifications

  • Ansible automation certifications

  • Networking or cybersecurity certifications

  • Degree qualifications in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or a related discipline

Why VERIDAPT?

At VERIDAPT, you’ll work on technology that supports customers operating across industrial environments around the world. You’ll join a collaborative engineering team where you can have genuine ownership, solve complex technical problems and directly influence the reliability and security of our platform.

Our values guide how we work: Innovate with Purpose, Tenacity to Power Through, Collaborate to Succeed and Trust Through Action.

The benefits

  • 6-month contract

  • Based in Manila, Philippines

  • Hybrid working arrangement - No regular travel required, with only ad hoc travel for team meetings or company events

If you’re an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys getting hands-on across infrastructure, automation, security and production systems, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Indirect Administration & Objections Coordinator
description:
Indirect Administration & Objections Coordinator

Salary: Up to £28,000 per annum (DOE)

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and highly organised Indirect Administration & Objections Coordinator to join our growing Indirect Channel team.

The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day administration of the channel, managing supplier information requests, progressing objection cases, maintaining accurate contract records, and ensuring a seamless experience for both partners and internal stakeholders.

Working closely with Relationship Managers, Business Development Managers, the Objections Team, Customer Services, and energy suppliers, you'll help ensure contracts are processed efficiently, objections are resolved promptly, and all administrative processes are completed to the highest standard.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary of up to £28,000 (DOE)

  • Up to 23 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays

  • Gifted annual leave over the festive period

  • Private Health Insurance including optical and dental cover

  • Fully funded gym membership

  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

  • Fully expensed social events including nights out and corporate hospitality

  • Relaxed working environment

  • Work anniversary and birthday gifts

  • Weekly recognition

  • Dress-down Fridays with a 3pm finish

  • Free on-site parking

Key Responsibilities

Information Requests & Supplier Liaison

  • Manage incoming information requests from suppliers and internal departments.

  • Obtain and validate contract information required for processing and renewals.

  • Liaise with energy suppliers to gather outstanding customer and contract data.

  • Ensure all information requests are completed accurately and within agreed service levels.

  • Maintain detailed and accurate records of all requests and supplier interactions.

Objections Management

  • Manage objection cases from receipt through to resolution.

  • Investigate objections by gathering information from suppliers and internal stakeholders.

  • Work closely with the Objections Team to progress and resolve cases efficiently.

  • Monitor objection workflows and provide updates on outstanding cases.

  • Ensure all objection records are maintained accurately and compliantly.

Contract Administration

  • Profile SME and bespoke contracts.

  • Complete contract checks including contract end dates, debt checks, supporting information, and renewal opportunities.

  • Maintain accurate and compliant contract records.

  • Track contract progress and ensure all documentation is complete.

  • Manage and chase outstanding lock-ins to support contract progression.

TPI & Partner Administration

  • Set up and maintain TPI partner accounts.

  • Create and manage user access and permissions.

  • Keep partner records accurate and up to date.

  • Provide administrative support to Relationship Managers and the wider channel team.

  • Assist with onboarding new TPI partners.

Operational Support

  • Support pricing and commercial administration activities when required.

  • Assist with supplier quotations and supporting documentation.

  • Maintain high standards of accuracy across all administration tasks.

  • Ensure compliance with internal processes and regulatory requirements.

  • Identify opportunities to improve systems, processes, and efficiencies across the channel.

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Strong administration and organisational skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Confident using Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.

  • Experience working with CRM systems and internal databases.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Proactive and solution-focused approach to problem-solving.

Desirable

  • Previous experience in an administrative, operations, or sales support role.

  • Experience dealing with objections, disputes, complaints, or contract queries.

  • Knowledge of the energy industry or TPI market.

  • Experience working with supplier portals and contract processing.

  • Understanding of sales support and customer service environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • Information requests are completed accurately and within agreed timescales.

  • Objection cases are managed efficiently and resolved promptly.

  • Contract records remain accurate, compliant, and up to date.

  • Relationships with suppliers and partners are maintained to a high standard.

  • Administrative processes run smoothly and support the commercial success of the Indirect Channel.

This role is ideal for a candidate who enjoys administration, problem-solving, supplier engagement, and working in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail and organisation are essential.

title: Teknikinformatör inom ILS
description:
Om företaget

Hos Avaron får du tryggheten i en fast anställning kombinerat med variationen av att arbeta ute hos olika kunder. Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.

Om rollen

Du får en viktig roll i gränslandet mellan teknik, informationsstruktur och Integrated Logistics Support. Här arbetar du med avancerade tekniska produkter där tydlig, korrekt och spårbar information är avgörande för att systemen ska kunna användas, underhållas och vidmakthållas på ett säkert och effektivt sätt genom hela livscykeln.

Du blir en del av ett ILS-team där teknikinformatörer och logistikingenjörer samarbetar kring komplexa tekniska system. I rollen omsätter du tekniska underlag till strukturerad och användbar dokumentation, samtidigt som du bidrar till ordning, kvalitet och tillgänglighet i teknisk och logistisk information. Det här är en spännande möjlighet för dig som vill arbeta nära avancerad teknik och ha direkt påverkan på hur systemen fungerar över tid.

Arbetsuppgifter
  • Du skapar, strukturerar, uppdaterar och kvalitetssäkrar teknisk information och dokumentation.
  • Du bearbetar tekniska underlag till tydlig, korrekt och användaranpassad information.
  • Du tar fram och reviderar exempelvis tekniska manualer, underhållsinstruktioner och annan dokumentation för användning och underhåll.
  • Du samlar in och tolkar information från konstruktörer, systemingenjörer, logistikingenjörer och andra tekniska specialister.
  • Du registrerar, strukturerar och kvalitetssäkrar teknisk och logistisk data i Excel och andra informationssystem.
  • Du säkerställer kvalitet, struktur och spårbarhet i informationen.
  • Du stöttar även teamet i enklare ILS-relaterade uppgifter och analyser.
Krav
  • Relevant teknisk utbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.
  • Erfarenhet av teknisk dokumentation, teknisk information eller liknande arbete.
  • God förmåga att strukturera och kvalitetssäkra större mängder information och data.
  • God datorvana och erfarenhet av Excel samt informationshanteringssystem.
  • God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.
  • Möjlighet att genomgå och godkännas i en säkerhetsprövning (kräver svenskt medborgarskap, dubbla medborgarskap medges ej)
Meriterande
  • Erfarenhet av ILS, Integrated Logistics Support.
  • Erfarenhet av S1000D eller andra standarder för strukturerad teknisk information.
  • Erfarenhet av XML-baserad informationshantering.
  • Erfarenhet av ILS- eller dokumentationssystem.
  • Erfarenhet av fartyg, marina system eller örlogsfartyg.
  • Erfarenhet från försvarsindustrin, Försvarsmakten eller andra verksamheter med komplexa tekniska system.
Vi erbjuder
  • Fast anställning hos Avaron AB
  • Tjänstepension
  • Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr per år
Ansökan

Vi tillsätter löpande – sök gärna så snart du kan.

title: Yrkeslärare inom Ventilation
description:
Som yrkeslärare inom Movant är du med och förverkligar vår vision ”Från jobbdröm till drömjobb”.

Om rollenHar du några år i yrket som Ventilationsmontör eller Ventilationsplåtslagare och känner att det är dags för nästa steg? Movant startar upp en ny inriktning på vår enhet i Kalmar och söker dig som har yrkesbevis som ventilationsmontör alternativ ventilationsplåtslagare. Har du dessutom pedagogisk erfarenhet som exempelvis handledare ute på arbetsplatser är det meriterande. Här får du chansen att kombinera din yrkeskunskap med ett betydelsefullt uppdrag som mentor och utbildare för unga vuxna som vill ta steget in i Ventilationsbranschen.

För att trivas i rollen som lärare hos oss är det viktigt att du är en lagspelare som trivs med att arbeta i grupp. Det är viktigt att du har förmåga och vilja att utveckla människor genom att dela med dig av dina yrkeskunskaper. Din personlighet kännetecknas av en god samarbetsförmåga och en flexibilitet. Du har en förmåga att skapa goda relationer med alla du möter i ditt arbete. title: Production Team Member
location: Ashby de la Zouch, England, United Kingdom
description:
Production Team Member
Ashby-de-la-Zouch (Home of Hula Hoops, popchips, Nik Naks, and more…)
Shift: 2-2-3 rotating shift pattern | 12-hour day and night shifts (06:00 - 18:00 / 18:00 - 06:00)

Join our snack-loving team
We’re looking for Production Team Members to join us at KP Snacks. If you’re ready to bring your ideas to the table, grow your skills and be part of a team that values what makes you, you – this could be your next big move.

Who are we?
We’re KP Snacks, part of the Intersnack family. Across more than 30 countries, over 15,000 of us work together to make the snacks people love – from Hula Hoops to McCoy’s. In the UK, we’re a team of around 2,400 colleagues, based across seven sites and our Slough HQ. We’re proud of our close-knit culture, where we speak up, celebrate differences and push boundaries together.

About the role

As a Production Team Member, you’ll play a key role in ensuring our high-quality products are produced efficiently and to the highest standards. You’ll be responsible for the competent operation of a variety of machinery, including packing lines, poppers, and flavour units, while also carrying out routine product testing and quality checks to maintain consistency.

What’s in it for you?
We believe in rewarding our colleagues and helping them thrive. Here’s a flavour of what we offer:

  • Competitive annual salary

  • KP Pension Plan with up to 7% matched contributions

  • 26 days holiday, with the option to buy up to five additional days for more flexibility

  • Comprehensive healthcare support including Health Cash Plan, Digital GP and Employee Assistance Programme

  • KP4ME benefits platform with discounts, cashback, wellbeing tools and everyday savings

  • Enhanced family-friendly policies to support colleagues at every stage of life

What will you be doing?

  • Operate production machinery confidently and safely, including packing lines, poppers, and flavour units, to keep production running smoothly.

  • Embrace the challenge of maintaining high product quality, carrying out testing and checks to ensure every item meets our exacting standards.

  • Work closely with your shift team and other departments, supporting a collaborative and efficient production environment.

  • Play a vital role in delivering the products our customers love, contributing directly to our performance and reputation.

  • Gain hands-on experience and develop new skills, with full training provided and opportunities to grow within a fast-paced manufacturing setting.

We’d love to hear from you if you can bring:

  • A good standard of literacy and numeracy will help you follow processes accurately and complete essential documentation.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to work safely and efficiently will support the team in meeting daily production targets.

  • Previous experience in a manufacturing or food production environment is a great foundation, but we also welcome skills from similar hands-on roles.

  • A Level 2 Food Safety qualification is desirable but not essential—we provide full training to help you succeed and grow in the role.

  • A positive attitude, willingness to learn, and commitment to working well with others will ensure you thrive and live our KP values every day.

Our purpose
At KP Snacks, we're passionate about creating happy snacking moments through our great tasting snacks and iconic brands. Every day, millions of people enjoy our products, including Hula Hoops, McCoy's, KP Nuts, Tyrrells, Skips, POM-BEAR and Butterkist, making us one of the UK's leading snack manufacturers.

For decades, we've been delighting consumers by combining well-loved favourites with exciting innovations that reflect changing tastes and expectations. We're equally passionate about our people and committed to creating a workplace where everyone can grow, develop and make a real impact.

As part of the Intersnack Group, one of the world's leading snack manufacturers, we combine global expertise with a shared commitment to creating happy snacking moments every day.

We’re committed to inclusion
We’re building a workplace where everyone belongs. If you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you – your unique perspective could be just what we need. And if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you, just let us know.

title: Project Manager
description:
Join ICOMAT – Revolutionising the Future of Lightweight Manufacturing!

iCOMAT is an advanced manufacturing company that invented Rapid Tow Shearing (RTS) - the only proven technology for producing defect-free curved-fiber composite parts at industrial scale. We deliver the lightest structures possible for aerospace, automotive, defense, and space, at a rate and cost efficiency that far exceeds existing composite production processes.

We build and operate automated factories for composite materials, delivering components to Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs. The business has three main divisions: development of automated production machines, development of software design and production tools, and operation of the factory. We work with 25+ customers and completed the largest ever Series A in composites manufacturing to fuel a significant scale-up, with growth plans that will see the business multiply in size over the next two to three years and expand operations into the UK, Europe and the US.

The business has currently more than 130,000 sqm of production capacity with manufacturing facilities in the UK (Gloucester and Swindon) and the US (Dayton, Ohio); a Hardware R&D Centre in Bristol, UK; and a Software R&D Centre in Athens, Greece.

As Project Manager you will own delivery of the projects assigned to you, from kick-off through to completion. You will hold the plan, the budget and the deliverables, and you will be the one accountable when a milestone is at risk. Today we deliver components to more than 25 customers from two operational UK factories, with a third facility coming online in the US. The role is based at Factory 1 in Gloucester and reports to the Head of Project Management.


What will you be doing?

Project Planning & Execution

Developing detailed project plans, setting timelines, defining milestones and coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure timely and effective project delivery. You will build and maintain plans with real critical paths, resource loading and dependencies, and keep them honest as the work moves.

Budget Management

Overseeing project budgets, monitoring expenditure and identifying cost-saving opportunities while ensuring high-quality standards. You will keep cost and schedule visible in the same picture, so trade-offs get made with the full facts.

Stakeholder Communication

Acting as the main point of contact for internal teams, customers and external stakeholders, ensuring clear and proactive communication throughout the project lifecycle. Reporting is concise, honest and on time, and always paired with the corrective action.

Risk Management

Identifying potential project risks, implementing mitigation strategies and adapting to change swiftly to keep projects on track. Risks get found early, quantified, mitigated and escalated long before they become schedule problems.

Continuous Improvement

Analysing project outcomes, providing insights for future projects and contributing to iCOMAT’s culture of continuous improvement and innovation. As the project management function grows you will help shape the templates, governance and reporting cadence that everyone works to.

What do we need from you?

  • Hands-on project management in a manufacturing, engineering or technical environment is the number one requirement: you have delivered physical hardware to customer schedules, through industrialisation and into production

  • Experience in aerospace, automotive or space, ideally within the composites or materials science industry

  • A track record of running multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously without losing control of any of them

  • Strong organisational, problem-solving and communication skills, with the credibility to hold stakeholders to a plan

  • Commercial awareness across budgets, cost and change control

  • Strong Office 365 skills, particularly Project, Excel and PowerPoint

  • A proactive, adaptable and collaborative professional who thrives in a fast-paced, high-tech environment

Nice to have

  • Composites manufacturing experience

  • Formal project management certification (APM, PMP or PRINCE2)

  • Experience of grant-funded projects (Innovate UK, ATI or ESA)

  • Experience taking a product from prototype through to rate production in a fast-growing business

  • Exposure to AS9100 and OEM customer-specific programme requirements

Our Values: Uncompromising Excellence

  • Discipline over excuses. We commit. We follow through. We hold ourselves and each other to the highest standard, especially when the pressure is on.

  • Push the edge. iCOMAT was built on a refusal to accept that curved fiber could not be manufactured at scale. We innovate where others hesitate.

  • Aligned and accountable. Everyone owns their lane, communicates openly, and delivers without being chased. No silos. No ambiguity.

Why iCOMAT?

  • Competitive Salary & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including private healthcare, pension scheme.

  • Stock Options: Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success

  • Career Growth Opportunities: Join us at a pivotal time as we scale up, offering unmatched professional growth opportunities in the rapidly advancing field of composite materials.

  • Innovation-Focused Culture: We pride ourselves on our inclusive, forward-thinking work environment. Recognized by Bloomberg as a "UK Startup to Watch," iCOMAT celebrates diversity and encourages all applicants, regardless of background, to apply.

  • Global Impact: Be a part of our mission to redefine lightweight structures for the automotive, aerospace, and space industries, working with some of the most influential companies worldwide.Ready to be part of something big?

Apply now to learn more and join us on our exciting journey!

title: Senior Application Consultant
description:

title: Business Area Lead, AWS
description:
SwedQ is a consultancy that has lately proven to have a model that works for people who want to build something rather than just deliver hours. Year after year we have served clients across a wide range of industries (still intentionally excluding gambling and weaponry), and we have grown steadily in revenue, in team size and in the weight of what we deliver.

Now we are building AWS into a business area of its own. Both as a reseller and as the team that delivers the projects that follow. We are looking for the person who is going to run it.

You get two things on day one. The first is a client base where we already deliver consultants but where the cloud consumption sits somewhere else entirely. The second is a blank page.

What the role actually is

You own the P&L. Revenue, margin, pricing, budget, the lot. You decide what we sell, at what margin, and how we deliver it.

The first job is the money that is already close. We have clients who trust us and who buy their cloud elsewhere. Going and getting that is where you start. After that comes new mid market clients in the Nordics, companies in the 200 to 2000 employee range where we can actually make a difference instead of being supplier number fourteen.

You will own the relationship towards AWS and towards our distributors, and push our partner status forward. You will sit with the client's architect as often as you sit with their CTO, and you need to hold your own in both conversations without bringing someone along to translate. And you will work closely with our consultants, because we do not sell things we cannot deliver.

When the business area grows, you hire into it. You report to the CEO.

Who we think you are

You have five years or more in technical sales, business development or partner business within cloud, IT consulting or distribution. You understand the economics of cloud resale, meaning margin structure, commitments, cost optimisation, and not only how to close a project.

You come from a technical background, or you have worked close enough to the technology that you can reason about architecture and migration paths on your own. You either hold AWS certifications or you take them within six months, and we pay for them.

You want ownership of a result rather than a quota. If a target handed to you by someone else is what motivates you, this is probably the wrong company.

Swedish and English, both working level. Experience with Swedish framework agreements and public procurement is a plus, as is having built a business from nothing before.

What is in it for you?

The question goes back to you: what do you want (with common sense or not)? We are looking for someone who wants to be part of the company in a literal sense. That means taking on the commercial challenges as well as getting a portion of the company in the future.

SwedQ culture

SwedQ began with siblings who brought in people they knew. Those people recommended friends, and from there the company grew further through open head hunting. Over time we have built a diverse team with different backgrounds, experiences and insights. We made sure to amplify that by embracing independence and accountability while driving value creating work. We are 25 people, not 1300. Nobody hands you a territory inside somebody else's plan.

Sounds like you? Apply, or just get in touch and ask.

Founded in 1901, the Virginia Zoo is located in Norfolk, VA and is home to more than 700 animals representing over 150 species. It resides on 53 acres and is mostly outdoors with an indoor World of Reptiles exhibit, 3 classrooms, and an indoor restaurant and gift shop.


The Animal Ambassador Specialist at the Virginia Zoo provide the highest level of animal welfare for the Virginia Zoo’s Animal Ambassadors. Animal Ambassador Specialists are responsible for the husbandry, training, providing enrichment, and public presentations with all species in the Virginia Zoo animal ambassador program animal collection. Duties involve animal husbandry, training, record keeping, and contributing to creating and presenting enrichment opportunities for animal ambassadors. Animal Ambassador Specialists contribute to the Virginia Zoo mission by delivering public facing education presentations with our Animal Ambassadors.


This is a full-time, Non-Exempt position reporting to the Curator - Animal Ambassadors with the Virginia Zoological Society.


Schedule does vary to include weekends and occasional evenings.


Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for animal ambassador diet preparation, delivery, feeding, monitoring, and recording.
  • Observes and maintain daily documentation of animal ambassadors to include checking for medical issues, changes in behavior, feeding habits, and overall wellbeing.
  • Contribute for the care of animals as specified by supervisory and veterinary staff in accordance with nutritional, social, physical, and behavioral requirements.
  • Cleans, disinfects, and maintains animal exhibits, enclosures, food and water dishes, pools, and other areas.
  • Maintains and updates all records and information pertaining to animal ambassadors.
  • Maintain up to date knowledge and best practices of behavioral characteristics and handling procedures for assigned animals.
  • Maintain up to date knowledge and ability to conduct animal restraint and operate restraint apparatus such as squeeze cages safely.
  • Conduct research and follow breeding recommendations and protocol set by the Species Survival Plan (SSP).
  • Administer prescribed medical treatment to animal ambassadors as directed by the Zoo Veterinarian.
  • Responsible for cleaning and routine maintenance of animal enclosures, both inside and outside.
  • Contributes with writing animal training plans and engages in training sessions with animals within the animal ambassador department that are voluntary and positive for the animals.
  • Creates perching, shelter, and other animal enclosure furniture features as appropriate for the species and individual animal to provide enrichment.
  • Maintain proper up-to-date knowledge of AZA standards regarding animal handling, animal husbandry, animal welfare, and presentations.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of best practices in animal husbandry, training, enrichment, and educational presentations.
  • Contribute to writing animal enrichment proposals that provides stimulating and safe enrichment opportunities to the animals with the goal of eliciting natural behaviors.
  • Acts as a resource for education staff/volunteers working in the area and/or with animal ambassadors.
  • May assist in working special events or programs as needed for program animal presentation.
  • Contribute to the upkeep of Animal Ambassador handbook consisting of bio-facts, training methods, animal handling procedures, and best practices as required by AZA standards.
  • Diligently adheres to all safety protocols and area standard operating procedures.
  • Track participation of animal ambassador utilized in presentations on a daily/weekly/monthly basis.
  • Track and record guest counts for animal interactions.
  • Contribute to the education and best practices of animal handling of education staff and approved volunteers.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Perks For working at the Virginia Zoo!

  • Positive, fun atmosphere.
  • 15 Paid holidays
  • Generous amount of PTO
  • Comprehensive health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and retirement plan are offered following a 60-day probationary period.
  • Free Zoo membership.
  • Discounts in the gift shop and restaurants.
  • Behind-The-Scenes tour.

title: Senior Fund Implementation Associate (M)
description:
Why Blue Coding?

At Blue Coding, we specialize in hiring excellent professionals and amazing people from all over Latin America and other parts of the world. For the past 12 years, we've helped cutting-edge companies in the United States and Canada build great teams and achieve their goals. Large multinationals, digital agencies, SaaS providers, and software consulting firms are just a few of our clients. Our team of over 150 professionals, including engineers, project managers, finance and accounting specialists, QA and UX/UI designers, and many more, is distributed across more than 10 countries in the Americas. We are a fully remote company working across a wide range of industries and disciplines, with expertise at every stage of the talent engagement process.

Our team is highly connected, united, and culturally diverse, and our collaborators are involved in many initiatives around the world, from wildlife preservation to volunteering at local charities. We stand for honesty, fairness, respect, efficiency, hard work, and cooperation

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a Senior Associate to join the Implementation team of one of our U.S.-based clients, a company building fund management software for the private funds industry. This role is for a professional with real industry experience as a fund accountant, private funds operations professional, or implementation specialist at a fund administrator, fund manager, or fund management software provider. What matters most is that you understand the complexity of private funds and enjoy the hands-on work of configuring, testing, and implementing solutions.

You'll be part of the Implementation team, working closely with the client's U.S.-based Implementation, Product, and Engineering teams to bring their product to life for clients. This is hands-on implementation work: configuring, testing, and validating client fund structures and calculations. At the Senior Associate level, you'll own either a substantial piece of a more complex implementation or a full, straightforward implementation end-to-end, with minimal oversight, identifying edge cases, proposing solutions rather than just executing tasks, and guiding Associates on specific pieces of work.

This role is not client-facing today. The U.S. team owns the direct client relationship while you focus on the technical execution behind each implementation. As you build expertise and the nearshore team grows, there may be opportunities to expand into direct client ownership.

Here are some of the exciting day-to-day challenges you will face in this role:

  • Develop deep, hands-on fluency in the platform: fund structures, calculations, and implementation workflows.
  • Own a substantial piece of a complex implementation, or a full, straightforward implementation end-to-end, with minimal oversight.
  • Identify edge cases and propose solutions, rather than simply executing tasks handed to you.
  • Guide Associates on specific pieces of work.
  • Partner with the U.S. Implementation, Product, and Engineering teams, surfacing edge cases and issues uncovered during testing and implementation.
  • Help pressure-test and refine implementation processes that are still evolving, adapting quickly as workflows and tooling change.

You will shine if you have:

  • 3–5 years of relevant private funds industry experience (fund accounting, private funds operations, or implementation).
  • Prior experience implementing software, systems, or operational processes — you know what it takes to take something from spec to live and working.
  • A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken, and comfort communicating clearly with cross-border teams in the U.S.
  • Comfort getting hands-on with complex fund structures and calculations to build clear, scalable solutions.
  • Experience managing or working with large, complex data sets, and the attention to detail that requires.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to build or support automations (e.g., automating repetitive workflows, data processing, or testing).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
  • A CPA or equivalent experience is a plus.

Who You Are

  • Hands-On: You're energized by doing the work directly: configuring, testing, troubleshooting, not just directing others to do it.
  • Collaborative: You work well in a dynamic, cross-functional environment, partnering closely with U.S.-based teammates and excelling at giving and incorporating feedback.
  • Adaptable: You're comfortable with processes that are still being defined, and you adjust quickly as workflows, priorities, and tools evolve.
  • Detail-Oriented: There is no room for error when building software to manage critical calculations for investment managers.
  • Growth-Minded: You're motivated by the possibility of taking on more scope over time.
  • Curious: You enjoy learning about different technical concepts and clients' unique approaches to managing their fund finance operations.

Ready to learn more? Apply below!

title: Product Owner
description:
The Data & AI Product Owner will be responsible for defining and driving the product strategy, roadmap and execution of data and AI initiatives. This role requires a deep understanding of data science, machine learning and AI technologies, as well as the ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable business solutions. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of managing AI products from conception to launch, with a strong focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.

What will be your responsibilities:

  • Product Strategy and Vision: Develop and communicate a clear product vision and strategy for AI-driven solutions, aligned with the company's overall objectives. Define and communicate the Product vision, strategy and roadmap for the AI and data products in your portfolio;

  • Roadmap Planning: Create and maintain a detailed product roadmap that outlines key milestones, deliverables and timelines;

  • Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including data scientists, engineers, business analysts and customers, to gather requirements, prioritize features and ensure alignment;

  • Product Development: Lead the product development lifecycle, from ideation and design to implementation, testing and release. Ensure that AI models and data solutions meet high standards of quality, scalability and performance;

  • Work closely with data scientists, engineers, hardware teams and other team members to deliver innovative AI and data solutions;

  • Manage the product backlog, including writing clear and actionable user stories and acceptance criteria;

  • Prioritize and sequence the backlog according to business value and customer needs;

  • Lead sprint planning and reviews;

  • Performance Metrics: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success. Utilize data-driven insights to make informed decisions and drive continuous improvement;

  • Monitor product performance and gather feedback to inform future development;

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of the Data & AI products within your portfolio;

  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies in AI and data.

Profile and requirements:

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related field (Masters degree is a plus);

  • Preferred location of working: UK, Portugal , France and/or Spain

  • Proven experience (3+ years) as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar role in the tech industry, with a focus on data and artificial intelligence products;

  • Strong understanding of AI and data technologies, including machine learning, big data and data analytics. Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, data analytics and data engineering. Experience with AI platforms, tools and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn);

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders;

  • Proven leadership skills with the ability to inspire and guide cross-functional teams;

  • Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced, dynamic environment;

  • Experience with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Scrum, Jira);

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making;

  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable plans and requirements;

  • Hands-on with solid technical acumen;

  • A passion for innovation and staying ahead of industry trends;

  • Ideally, in possession of Product Owner certification (e.g. ideally Professional Scrum Product Owner™ Certification (PSPO I), or Scrum Alliance Certified Scrum Product Owner® (CSPO®)).

  • Language Requirements: Advanced proficiency in Portuguese and English, with proven fluency at the C2 level in both languages.

What we have to offer you:

  • The opportunity to work in a leading innovative tech company;

  • A collaborative and dynamic work environment;

  • Professional growth opportunities in a globally expanding team;

  • Flexible work arrangements;

  • Salary compatible with the level of proven experience

  • Meal allowance and health insurance for employees

  • Shuttle transport service to the offices in Leiria, Caldas da Rainha and Ponte de Sor

  • Bonus in line with company policy

  • Access to the Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)

Compensation Transparency

Compensation within the posted salary range will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, and work location, consistent with applicable laws.

Pre-Employment Requirements

Employment offers may be contingent upon successful completion of a background check and reference verification, in accordance with applicable laws and company policy.

Företaget finns i hela Sverige och arbetet leds från vårt huvudkontor i Gamla Stan i Stockholm. Bolaget drivs av kliniskt verksamma specialistsjuksköterskor samt undersköterskor som är väl medvetna om vad som krävs av varje medarbetare för att kunna göra ett professionellt arbete.
