Ønsker du en meningsfull jobb hvor du virkelig kan gjøre en forskjell i et annet menneskes hverdag? Mio BPA søker nå flere assistenter til en BPA-ordning for en ung kvinne bosatt i Arendal kommune.

Ordningen er bemannet hele døgnet, og vi ser etter deg som er omsorgsfull, pålitelig og ønsker å bidra til at vedtakseier kan leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv på egne premisser.

Vedtakseier er glad i å være aktiv og setter pris på turer, hagearbeid, ulike fritidsaktiviteter og tid sammen med familien. Hun har også to servicehunder, så det er viktig at du ikke er allergisk mot hund eller har utfordringer med å omgås dyr.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som BPA-assistent vil du blant annet:

  • Legge til rette for en aktiv, trygg og meningsfull hverdag

  • Bistå med praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet

  • Gi hjelp til personlig stell

  • Bistå ved forflytning

  • Utføre stomistell

  • Delta i aktiviteter og sosiale sammenhenger etter behov

Du vil få grundig opplæring, og i oppstartsfasen vil du gå vakter sammen med en erfaren assistent for å bli trygg i rollen. Det viktigste er at du møter vedtakseier med respekt, forståelse og et ønske om å se personen bak funksjonsvariasjonen.

På grunn av stillingens karakter oppfordres kvinner til å søke.

Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidstid

Vi har ledig:

  • 4 helgestillinger med arbeid lørdag og søndag

  • Tilkallingsassistenter som kan stille ved sykdom og på kort varsel

Tilkallingsvaktene kan være på dag, kveld, natt og i helger. For begge stillingstyper er det viktig at du har kapasitet og fleksibilitet til å kunne stille opp ved behov, både på kort og lengre sikt.

Denne jobben passer godt for deg som ønsker en fleksibel arbeidshverdag, for eksempel ved siden av studier eller annen jobb, og som trives i et hjemmemiljø med varierte arbeidsoppgaver.

Arbeidstider

  • Dagvakt: kl. 07:45/08:00–15:30/16:00

  • Kveldsvakt: kl. 15:30–22:45

  • Våken nattevakt: kl. 22:00–08:00

Personlige egenskaper

  • Høy emosjonell intelligens

  • God på å samarbeide

  • Lagspiller med en sterk arbeidsmoral

  • Løsningsorientert og kreativ

  • Håndterer stress på en god måte

  • Er pliktoppfyllende

Det er et ekstra pluss dersom du er kreativ og flink til å motivere andre til å delta i aktiviteter og oppleve mestring i hverdagen.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Førerkort klasse B (manuell)

  • Gode norskkunnskaper

  • Plettfri vandel

  • Fordel med kjennskap til mennesker med en funksjonsvariasjon

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Jenny Dolven på epost: jenny.dolven@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

title: Class 1 HGV Driver
description:
Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for a position in which you can keep things moving and deliver when it matters most? If so, then you could be the newest addition to our team as a Class 1 HGV Driver.

Be part of the movement – and play your part.

About the role

Shifts Available: Nights (Thursday to Sunday), Days (Thursday to Sunday) & Tramping (Friday to Monday)

You’ll be working with fridge trailers, transporting fresh and frozen food.

You will be responsible for:

  • Driving Class 1 vehicles on regional and national routes

  • Handling chilled and frozen goods, monitoring fridge temperatures

  • Performing daily walkaround checks and reporting any issues

  • Completing delivery paperwork accurately

  • Following all road transport and tachograph regulations

  • Ensuring loads are secure and handled safely

About you

To join our team, you’ll need a full HGV Class 1 licence, along with a valid Driver CPC and tachograph card. Experience with fridge work is a bonus but not essential, as training can be provided. Most importantly, you’ll bring a professional attitude, strong communication skills, and a commitment to safety in everything you do.

We think the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. And we cannot wait for you to join.

Working at DFDS

Join the movement and grow with us.

We’ll support you on your journey and create the conditions that make it worthwhile.

We’ll encourage you to challenge yourself, to acquire new skills and attributes. We want you to develop and progress within your career. At DFDS, we believe that development happens first and foremost through activities in the workplace, and we've developed training courses to support you.

Now about what we can give you. You’ll be able to access some fantastic benefits such as:

  • Life assurance cover

  • Contributory company pension scheme

  • Holiday Purchase Scheme

  • Free ferry travel for up to 4 guests between Dover and Calais / Newcastle and Amsterdam with no limit on trips

  • Full employee assistance programme including:

  • Proactive financial, emotional, mental, and physical health care support including face to face counselling, fast 24/7 access to a GP, a second medical opinion and legal support for colleagues and their family.

  • Huge range of retail discounts from high street and online retailers

  • Cashback on health care including dental, optical, physiotherapy, prescriptions, specialist consultations and much more.

  • Access to myStrength, our Wellbeing platform, which has plenty of content to support and improve your mental wellness needs.

  • Access to mental health first aid and opportunity to join support webinars with a focus on all areas of positive wellbeing.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply now.

If you think your personality, skills, experience, and desire match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: IT Supporter
description:
Hos NORMAL fortsætter vi med at vokse, og vi søger nu en IT Supporter til vores IT Support-team i Skanderborg. Du bliver en del af et stærkt supportteam på ni kolleger, hvoraf fem er placeret i Skanderborg og yder IT-support til vores hovedkontorer og butikker.

I din hverdag kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med de øvrige IT Supportere og vores IT Operations-team for at sikre den bedst mulige service til alle vores butikker og kontorlokationer. Du får en bred kontaktflade og en hverdag, hvor du både kommer til at løse konkrete supportopgaver og være med til at sikre, at den daglige IT-drift fungerer.

Dine vigtigste ansvarsområder

Ikke to dage er ens, men dit primære fokus bliver at supportere vores butikker i tæt samarbejde med resten af IT-organisationen. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

· Yde 2nd level support til butikker og butikschefer

· Yde 1st level support til kolleger på vores hovedkontorer i forskellige lande

· Håndtere incidents og service requests via mail, telefon og walk-ins

· Vedligeholde masterdata og varetage brugeradministration

· Indkøbe, klargøre, opsætte og registrere udstyr

· Vedligeholde dokumentation og sikre løbende vidensdeling

· Følge proaktivt op på den daglige drift

· Koordinere og samarbejde med forskellige leverandører

Du kommer til at arbejde med en række Microsoft-baserede systemer, såsom MS Dynamics NAV & Business Central med LS Retail, Office 365, MS Entra, Active Directory, Targit (Business Intelligence) m.m.

Hvem er du?

Du er serviceminded og motiveres af at hjælpe brugere med at løse deres IT-udfordringer – altid med et smil. Du arbejder struktureret og systematisk og bevarer roen, også når der er travlt. Du går til både simple og mere komplekse supportopgaver med samme engagement og tager proaktivt ansvar for at finde en løsning.

Samtidig bidrager du til en positiv og hjælpsom teamkultur. Du er selvfølgelig også en god kollega, der har lyst til at være en del af det sociale fællesskab.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:

· har nogle års erfaring inden for IT, gerne med teknisk fokus eller fra teknisk support. Din praktiske erfaring vægter højere end din formelle uddannelse.

· har en nysgerrig og proaktiv tilgang til nye teknologier og IT-udfordringer

· har en grundlæggende forståelse for applikationslandskaber og IT-infrastruktur

· Kommunikerer ubesværet og trygt i skrift og tale – både på dansk og engelsk

· hvis du også kan kommunikere på et andet nordisk sprog, er det en fordel

Hvem er vi?

Spørger du vores kollegaer, vil de sige, at NORMAL er noget helt særligt. Fællesskabet er stort, og det kommer altid først – bogstaveligt talt. I NORMAL jagter vi nemlig ikke individuelle mål, men vi fejrer de resultater, vi skaber sammen. Fordi vi ved, at succes bliver bedre, når vi deler den.

Kulturen i NORMAL er uhøjtidelig, og vi møder hinanden i øjenhøjde med det fælles mål at opnå succes og resultater – samtidig med at vi har det rigtig sjovt og til tider løber stærkt. Og derudover har vi i øvrigt en af Danmarks bedste kantiner, hvor vi hver dag kommer hinanden ved på tværs af afdelinger.

Praktisk information

· Arbejdssted: On-site Skanderborg HQ - Der tilbydes ikke relocation assistance til denne stilling, og du skal have en gyldig dansk arbejdstilladelse

· Arbejdstid: Mellem kl. 7:00 og 17:00
Da der er tale om en supportfunktion, er mulighederne for hjemmearbejde begrænsede

Interesseret?
Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte IT Support Manager Henrik Lund på +45 20 89 92 68. Ellers send os dit CV sammen med et par ord om dig selv, og hvorfor du finder stillingen interessant.

Vi vurderer ansøgninger og afholder samtaler løbende. Bemærk, at vi lukker stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet det rette match.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig 😊

title: Events Assistant
description:
Mission & Values


The Virginia Zoo, founded in 1901 and located in Norfolk, Virginia, is home to more than 700 animals representing over 150 species across 53 acres of outdoor habitats, the World of Reptiles, classrooms, and guest amenities. The Zoo is committed to inspiring our community to take action to save the world’s wildlife and their ecosystems. Our vision is a world where everyone values wildlife and the environment.


We prioritize the health, safety, and well-being of every animal in our care. We empower our community to protect wildlife and ecosystems locally and globally. We create meaningful experiences that inspire curiosity, learning, and stewardship. We uphold ethical standards in all operations, partnerships, and interactions. We foster a welcoming environment where diverse perspectives strengthen our mission. We work together—staff, volunteers, city partners, and community to advance shared goals.


Position Summary


The Event Assistant supports the Events Manager and the Events Department in planning, coordinating, and executing engaging events at the Virginia Zoo. This role focuses on vendor coordination, onsite event support, and general administrative assistance. The Event Assistant also helps promote events by distributing Zoo-provided promotional materials within the community. Success in this position requires a highly organized, detail-oriented individual who is comfortable communicating with vendors, sponsors, guests, and community partners to ensure seamless event execution.


Essential Duties / Responsibilities

  • Assist with vendor communication, including DJs, bounce house rentals, food trucks, community partners, and local businesses.
  • Coordinate vendor logistics such as arrival times, load-in/load-out procedures, and contract requirements.
  • Maintain vendor agreements and ensure compliance with Zoo policies.
  • Support the development of new vendor partnerships and sponsorship coordination to enhance event offerings.
  • Distribute Zoo-provided flyers and promotional materials around the community to generate awareness and excitement for events.
  • Assist with event setup, breakdown, and onsite coordination.
  • Contribute to departmental brainstorming and planning sessions to explore new event ideas aligned with the vision and goals of the Virginia Zoo Events Department.
  • Provide general administrative support, including responding to event inquiries, organizing event documents, maintaining event checklists, timelines, itineraries, DJ notes, FAQs, vendor contact lists, and post-event reports.
  • Serve as an onsite point of contact for guests during events, answering questions about schedules, activities and amenities.
  • Assist with event signage and wayfinding placement to help guests navigate event activities.
  • Gather informal feedback from guests to support continuous improvement of events.
  • Collaborate with other Zoo departments and volunteers to ensure smooth event operations.
  • Conduct inventory audits of event supplies and coordinate reorders when necessary (e.g. signage, decorations, wristbands, table covers, giveaway items).
  • Assist with collecting attendee and staff feedback through surveys.
  • Provide post-event recaps including financial data, attendance and survey feedback.
  • Provide support for private rental events and birthday parties, before, during and after the event.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience

  • Experience in customer service, hospitality, or event support.
  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Hospitality, Event Planning, Tourism, Parks and Recreation, or Communications or equivalent experience.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Effective time-management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
  • Comfortable interacting with vendors, sponsors, and community members.
  • Ability to work independently while taking direction from the Events Manager.
  • Ability to function well in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality regarding donor and prospect information.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office or related software.
  • Ability to maintain a flexible schedule, including nights and weekends.
  • Ability to maintain an optimistic attitude when supporting guests, partners and zoo staff

Preferred Qualifications

  • One year or more of event, hospitality, customer service, or related experience.
  • Experience with site maps/plan-o-grams.
  • Experience as a venue coordinator and/or with outdoor events.
  • Experience coordinating with 3rd-party vendors.
  • Understanding and knowledge of the local Norfolk community.
  • Experience supporting marketing or promotional activities.

Physical Requirements / Working Conditions

  • Ability to stand, move, and walk for up to 8 hours a day.
  • Ability to lift and move objects including but limited to boxes, tables, and chairs, up to 35lbs.
  • Ability to work outdoors in various weather conditions.

Special Requirements

  • Valid driver’s license
  • Ability to pass a background check



Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

The Virginia Zoo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to

creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration

for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual

orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.


ADA Accommodation Statement

The Virginia Zoo is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with

disabilities to ensure equal access to employment opportunities and the essential functions of each

position. Applicants or employees who require accommodation may contact Human Resources to

initiate an interactive process.

title: Vehicle Integration Test Coordinator
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will help create structure and momentum in complete vehicle integration testing within a complex automotive environment. Here, software deliveries, electronics, embedded systems, and vehicle functions need to come together in a reliable way, and your coordination will make that possible.

In this role, you will bring clarity to ongoing test activities, manage dependencies, and support stakeholders with transparent follow-up and reporting. You will work across teams and help improve how testing is planned, coordinated, and communicated. There is also strong interest in using AI and digital tools to simplify workflows and increase efficiency. This is a great opportunity if you enjoy combining technical understanding with coordination and continuous improvement.

Job Description
  • You will coordinate test planning and execution across multiple teams.
  • You will maintain an operational overview of ongoing test activities, dependencies, and priorities.
  • You will follow up on progress, deviations, and reporting needs to create transparency in status and decision points.
  • You will drive cross-functional collaboration between software deliveries and complete vehicle teams.
  • You will facilitate meetings and alignment forums that help teams move forward together.
  • You will identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies when needed.
  • You will support the development, improvement, and simplification of test processes.
  • You will contribute to more efficient ways of working through AI-supported and digital tools for reporting and coordination.
Requirements
  • Relevant technical education, or equivalent work experience, within engineering, software, electronics, embedded systems, or vehicle systems.
  • Experience in test coordination, test planning, verification, validation, or technical project coordination.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholders.
  • Good understanding of test processes, reporting, follow-up, and risk and dependency management.
  • Experience from software and hardware integration, or from larger technical systems.
  • English and Swedish.
Nice to have
  • Education or certification in test methodology, project coordination, agile ways of working, systems engineering, or similar.
  • Experience from automotive, embedded systems, HIL/SIL, complete vehicle testing, or system integration.
  • Experience with process improvement, automation, AI-supported workflows, or digitalization of test and reporting processes.
  • Experience facilitating meetings and creating alignment between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
What We Offer
  • Permanent employment at Avaron AB
  • Occupational pension
  • Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year
Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Investment Graduate
description:
As a member of the Bespoke Investment Management team you will assist in the on boarding of new clients along with the maintenance of existing clients. You will also commence or continue your study to enable you to develop into a junior investment manager. This will involve you undertaking the CISI or CFA exam program over a three to four year period.

Key responsibilities
  • Assist with ongoing client relationship management, including incoming and outgoing communication, account opening coordination and portfolio enquiries.
  • Assist with the client take on process, coordinating efforts with other departments within the business to ensure the smoothest possible outcome for the client.
  • Take responsibility for checking new business paperwork, scanning documents, managing cash balances and cash movements, updating static client information, preparing valuations, archiving documents and other general ad hoc client maintenance and office duties.
  • Assist clients with all administration-related queries, offering support to other team members if required in order to efficiently and effectively respond.
  • Assist with correct record keeping practices across the team, highlighting and rectifying any issues across company systems.
  • Gather and assist in the production of suitability documentation and ensure reviews are completed as required according to individual client agreements.
  • Proactively seek to improve on processes and procedures within the scope of this role, challenging where required and taking an active role in their own continuous learning.
  • During your study, seek to understand the investment framework at TrinityBridge, along with the relevant risk profiles and client suitability when assessing a client’s portfolio.


Regulatory responsibilities | Compliance/T&C
  • Ability to demonstrate an understanding of the regulatory framework relevant to the role, whilst practising effective risk management taking account of outcomes for clients.

  • Understand, follow and demonstrate compliance with all relevant internal and external rules, regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of the business. Follow principles and rules of the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and the internal requirements set out in the Compliance Manual, local and Group Compliance and Risk policies.


About you | Qualifications, skills and strengths
  • Educated to at least undergraduate level
  • Strong interest in finance, economics and companies
  • Numerate with Strong MS Office skills; Word (intermediate level), Excel (intermediate level – basic formulas), PowerPoint (intermediate level), Outlook (intermediate level)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills (verbal and written) including Report writing.
  • Personal values that demonstrate the ability to listen, patience and to empathise with respect.
  • Proactive nature, demonstrating a desire to gain efficiencies and improve procedures
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines with consistent accuracy and willing to help and assist to get the right client outcome
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Confident to suggest ways of improving the service currently offered
  • Proven ability to take the initiative

At TrinityBridge we look to recruit individuals from all different backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We celebrate diversity, promote inclusivity and are open to discuss flexible work options to help you balance your work and home life.

We appreciate that from time to time, recruitment agencies will have speculative CVs that they may wish to submit to our Talent Acquisition team in relation to a specific role.

To avoid any ambiguity around fees, please note that speculative CVs received by TrinityBridge, that have not been authorised in advance, by us, will be ineligible for an agency fee. Thank you.
#LI-EM1 #LI-SY1

Responsibilities

As an employer, TrinityBridge is committed to equality and valuing diversity within its workforce. We provide equality of opportunity and will aim to ensure that no employee’s or candidates are subject to discrimination on grounds of any characteristics including but not withstanding gender, gender identity, marital status, sexual orientation, race, colour, nationality, religion, age, disability, working pattern, caring responsibilities, political beliefs.

Requirements

At TrinityBridge we are all connected by our mission to be leading UK Wealth Manager, growing trusted client relationships that last for generations.

We believe that everyone should think ahead, have a financial plan and invest wisely. Our clients are professionals, business owners, individuals, charities, families, and employers, who rely on our clear financial advice and investment management services to preserve and grow their long-term savings and investments.

We are a team of about 900 people based in 15 offices across the UK. Our geographic footprint means we can combine a local approach with face-to-face services to enable strong, long-term relationships with our clients.

Sustainability is fundamental to our purpose, and we have a responsibility to help address the social, economic and environmental challenges facing our business, colleagues and clients. We strive to do the right thing and are dedicated to helping the charities that matter most to our people.

We offer a wide range of inclusive benefits that provides our people with all the support they need to find a healthy balance in all aspects of their lives. We also invest in the growth of our people providing a sense of belonging and team spirit and the ability to thrive.

We recruit people from all backgrounds and are open to discussing all types of flexible working options, helping our people to balance work and home life and make practical choices for wellbeing while delivering impact where it matters, all of which contributes to our exceptional client experience.

We are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We make adjustments for people who have a disability or long-term condition so, if you need a job description or application form in an alternative format, or would like to discuss the recruitment process with us, please get in touch at TalentAcquisition@trinitybridge.com.

title: Arbetsterapeut till Reumatologimottagningen
description:
Välkommen som arbetsterapeut till oss på Reumatologimottagningen vid Östersunds Rehabcentrum. 

Reumatologimottagningen är en av flera verksamheter inom område Hjärta, Neurologi och Rehabilitering.        Vår verksamhet bedrivs på Remonthagen, belägen ca 2 km från Östersunds sjukhus. På Östersunds Rehabcentrum finns även rehabiliteringsmedicinskavdelning, rehabiliteringsmedicinsk mottagning och en smärtenhet. 

Reumatologimottagningen är en specialistklinik för utredning, vård och behandling av patienter med säkerställd eller misstänkt reumatisk inflammatorisk sjukdom. Enheten består av en omfattande poliklinisk verksamhet och har tillgång till vårdplats på rehabiliteringsavdelningen vid behov av slutenvård. Vår verksamhet består av ett multiprofessionellt team som omfattar läkare, sjuksköterskor, arbetsterapeut, fysioterapeuter, kurator, medicinska sekreterare och undersköterska vid eget laboratorium. Öppenvård bedrivs i form av enskilda besök, dagvård och viss gruppverksamhet.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Hos oss kommer du att arbeta i en multidisciplinär organisation. I rollen som arbetsterapeut arbetar du självständigt men även i team med andra yrkesprofessioner. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att bedöma, planera, åtgärda och utvärdera utifrån den arbetsterapeutiska processen och där insatserna följer de verksamhetsspecifika insatser utifrån nationella riktlinjer och personcentrerade vårdförlopp.  

Arbetet ställer stora krav på självständighet och eget ansvarstagande parallellt med förmåga till flexibilitet och god samarbetsförmåga i teamgemensamma uppgifter. Du bidrar aktivt och tillför arbetsterapeutisk kompetens såväl i teamet som i olika utvecklingsprojekt inom verksamhetsområdet.

I tjänsten kan viss del av arbetstiden fördelas med närliggande verksamhet, detta utifrån behov och möjlighet.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som är legitimerad arbetsterapeut, meriterande är några års yrkeserfarenhet, erfarenhet från att arbeta i team och intresse eller erfarenhet av reumatologisk rehabilitering. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet. Vi söker dig som har god samarbetsförmåga, god förmåga att planera och strukturera ditt arbete, samt engagemang i patientarbetet och utveckling av verksamheten. B-körkort krävs.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.

I Region Jämtland Härjedalen genomsyras vårt arbete av våra kärnvärden: vi skapar värde för de vi är till för, agerar med handlingskraft och strävar efter att alltid upplevas som pålitliga. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i en organisation där dessa värden präglar vardagen och där ditt arbete verkligen gör skillnad. 

Som medarbetare får du tillgång till ett brett utbud av förmåner via vår förmånsportal. Vi värnar om din hälsa och erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag eller friskvårdstimme. På Östersunds sjukhus kan du dessutom träna gratis på gymmet Zefyren och delta i ledarledda pass.  

Urval och tillsättning kan ske löpande under annonseringstiden, så vi ser gärna att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. 

Vi har ett etablerat medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss därför vänligt men bestämt kontakt med annonssäljare eller andra säljare av rekryteringstjänster.

title: Allround Medewerker Burgerzaken
description:
Allround Medewerker Burgerzaken

Als Allround Medewerker Burgerzaken werk je binnen een team dat volop in ontwikkeling is en streeft naar optimale dienstverlening voor inwoners. In deze functie ligt de nadruk op werkzaamheden binnen de Basisregistratie Personen (BRP), met specifieke aandacht voor aanvragen voor briefadressen en adresonderzoek.

Je voert zelfstandig werkzaamheden uit binnen de Burgerlijke Stand en BRP, beoordeelt documenten en aanvragen en bent voor collega’s een inhoudelijke vraagbaak bij complexe casuïstiek. Daarbij staan vakmanschap, zorgvuldigheid en persoonlijke dienstverlening centraal.

Wat je gaat doen:

  • Zelfstandig en accuraat uitvoeren van werkzaamheden binnen de Burgerlijke Stand en BRP;

  • Behandelen van aanvragen voor briefadressen;

  • Uitvoeren van adresonderzoeken;

  • Beoordelen en verwerken van relevante aanvragen en mutaties;

  • Beoordelen van buitenlandse brondocumenten op juistheid, echtheid en rechtsgeldigheid;

  • Behandelen van complexe casuïstiek binnen Burgerzaken;

  • Fungeren als inhoudelijk expert en vraagbaak voor collega’s;

  • Bijdragen aan een klantgerichte en zorgvuldige dienstverlening aan inwoners.

Wat jij meebrengt:

  • Mbo werk- en denkniveau op niveau 4;

  • Een afgerond NLQF4-diploma of een vergelijkbare opleiding BA-BZ of MLO-BZ (harde eis);

  • Aantoonbare werkervaring binnen Burgerzaken (harde eis);

  • Ervaring met werkzaamheden binnen de BRP;

title: Senior Backend Engineer Node.js TypeScript OpenSearch
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will join a backend team working on an API that delivers static and market data for financial instruments in a modern banking environment. The solution supports an investment app today and is designed to serve more retail channels over time, which means your work will sit close to both business value and end-user experience.

This is a role for you if you enjoy solving search-heavy backend challenges where performance really matters. OpenSearch is a central part of the platform, used not only for storage but as a search and ranking engine for finding, filtering, sorting and ranking instruments across multiple dimensions with high speed and low latency.

You will also work with the ingestion flow behind the API, where data from several external sources is collected, normalized and made ready for reliable use downstream. The focus is on building services that are trusted in production, shaped by customer needs and released continuously.

What makes this role especially interesting is the chance to influence a product where search quality, data accuracy and backend design directly support better investment decisions.

Job Description
  • You will build and improve backend APIs in Node.js and TypeScript for serving instrument and market data in production.
  • You will design, tune and evolve OpenSearch-based search and ranking capabilities, including indexing strategy, complex queries, aggregations and performance optimization.
  • You will develop data ingestion pipelines that combine, reconcile and normalize data from multiple external sources.
  • You will work closely with the team to understand customer needs and turn them into solutions that create clear value.
  • You will use TDD to shape code and system design, from unit tests to end-to-end flows with test containers that mirror live environments.
  • You will contribute to a delivery setup with daily releases, where reliable CI outputs and production-ready quality are essential.
Requirements
  • Extensive hands-on experience and deep knowledge of OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, especially as a search and ranking engine rather than only as storage.
  • Strong practical knowledge of indexing strategy, advanced query design, aggregations, multi-dimensional sorting and ranking, and performance tuning for low-latency workloads at scale.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Node.js and TypeScript for building production APIs.
  • Experience building data ingestion pipelines that combine and reconcile data from several external sources.
  • Experience working with TDD in backend development, including automated tests across different levels.
  • A strong interest in building solutions based on customer value and close collaboration within the team.
Nice to have
  • Experience self-hosting and operating OpenSearch or Elasticsearch clusters.
  • Interest in, or experience with, financial instruments, markets, key figures and financial analysis.
  • Experience working in an agile way.
What We Offer
  • Permanent employment at Avaron AB
  • Occupational pension
  • Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year
Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: IT-Forensiker till regionalt IT-brottscentrum
description:
Är du redo för en större uppgift? Vi söker nu IT-Forensiker som är ambitiösa, strukturerade, och har hög integritet. Polismyndigheten är Sveriges största myndighet med ca 40 700 medarbetare över hela landet. Hos oss får du möjlighet att bidra till Polisens uppdrag – att öka tryggheten och minska brottsligheten i samhället. 

Polismyndigheten är organiserad i sju polisregioner, ett antal nationella avdelningar samt rikspolischefens kansli. I Region Öst finns idag tre IT-forensiska grupper som är placerade i Eskilstuna, Nyköping, Norrköping, Linköping och Jönköping. Grupperna hör till regionens IT-brottscentrum (RC3) vilket är en del av den regionala utredningsenheten som tillsammans med polisområdena ansvarar för regionens utredningsverksamhet.

Det regionala IT-brottscentrumet är en organisatorisk enhet där flera olika kompetenser inom digital brottsutredning finns representerade.  IT-Forensik hanterar alla typer av utredningar inom Polismyndigheten där digital bevisning behöver säkras, bearbetas och analyseras.


6 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
I arbetsuppgifterna som IT-Forensiker kommer du att bistå utredare med forensisk bevis- och informationssäkring av digitala medier, som kan utgöra en viktig del i en brottsutredning. Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar att planera, säkra, extrahera, analysera och värdera digitala spår från elektroniska enheter eller källor. Teknikutvecklingen i samhället är en utmaning för vår verksamhet och vi ser ett ökande inflöde gällande AI genererat material vilket påverkar vårat arbete och ställer krav på ökad kompetens inom området och att vi följer med i utvecklingen.

Arbetsuppgifter:
• Du kommer att i operativt arbete biträda vid husrannsakningar där t.ex. elektroniska databärare ska säkras.
• Dokumentera och skriva protokoll på utfört uppdrag. 
• Vid behov lämna vittnesmål i samband med rättegång samt biträda vid förhör.
• Ingå i polisregionens it-forensiska beredskap. 
• Du kan bli exponerad för material som kan vara stötande och obehagligt genom ditt arbete.

Resor förekommer såväl inom regionen som nationellt och ibland med kort varsel.

KVALIFIKATIONER
• Eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT-säkerhet/IT-forensik, alternativt annan arbetslivserfarenhet eller utbildning som myndigheten bedömer relevant
• Bred kunskap inom IT
• Goda kunskaper om vanligt förekommande hårdvara, operativsystem och nätverk som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant
• Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska
• Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska 
• B-körkort

Vi ser det som meriterande om du även har:
• Dokumenterad AI kompetens.
• Erfarenhet av att inhämta, analysera och sammanställa information.
• Erfarenhet av att hantera sekretessbelagd information och hantera material som kan uppfattas som stötande.
• Förmågan att undersöka skadlig kod, framförallt i Python men även i C, C++ samt Java.
• Erfarenhet av reparation av elektronik, exempelvis mobiltelefon skärmar eller kontakter.

Personliga egenskaper
Vi söker en driven och ambitiös medarbetare som är strukturerad och ansvarstagande. Eftersom arbetet innebär många kontaktytor både internt och externt, behöver du ha god samarbetsförmåga där du kommunicerar och relaterar till andra på ett lyhört och konstruktivt sätt.   • 👕 Volle Arbeitskleidung und Sicherheitsschuhe stellen wir dir

Deine Aufgaben

  • Scooter einsammeln, bereitstellen und die Logistik dahinter organisieren

  • Batterien wechseln

Das bringst du mit

Must-have:

  • Gültiger EU-Führerschein Klasse B, seit mindestens 2 Jahren

Nice-to-have:

Bring nicht alles mit? Bewirb dich trotzdem – wir bringen dir den Rest bei.

Gut zu wissen:

12-monatiger befristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit Option auf Verlängerung.

Warum Voi?

Wir sind Europas führendes Mikromobilitätsunternehmen und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Scale-ups. Bei uns arbeitest du mit einem vielfältigen, motivierten Team zusammen und trägst direkt dazu bei, Hamburg sauberer, ruhiger und lebenswerter zu machen.

Bist du bereit für deine Voiage? Bewirb dich jetzt.

—----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Your mission at Voi

As a driver / service driver, you'll keep our e-scooter fleet in Stuttgart up and running. Some days you're out in a van handling logistics across the city; other days you're working with the team on maintenance and quick on-site repairs. Without you, Munich's fleet doesn't move.

What you get from us

For this role, that includes:

  • 🏥 Health: A free Urban Sports Club Classic package (worth €59 a month), plus access to our Employee Assistance Programme whenever you need support

  • 🌴 Time off: 30 paid vacation days a year

  • 🛴 Ride: Unlimited Voi rides through Voi4Business — on and off the clock

  • 💶 Future: After probation, we contribute 4.5% of your salary to your pension every month through Allianz

  • 🎉 Community: Summer Summit, Winter Summit, Voi birthday celebrations and regular team events

  • 🛡️ Cover: Through our partnership with BG Verkehr, you're covered for accidents to, from and at work

  • 🤝 Referrals: Bring in a great colleague and earn a referral bonus of €1,000–3,000, depending on the role

What you'll do

  • Keep the logistics running for collecting and redeploying Voi scooters

  • Find and collect damaged scooters

  • Swap batteries

  • Carry out quick repairs on-site

  • Diagnose and fix broken vehicles

  • Recycle and dismantle vehicles that can't be repaired

  • Receive, package and prepare new vehicles and batteries arriving at the warehouse

  • Support the on-site team — spotting damaged vehicles, clearing parking spaces, or picking up vehicles that have fallen over

What you'll need

Must-have:

  • A valid EU driving licence, Class B, held for at least 2 years

  • Fluent German or English

  • Comfortable doing physical work for several hours at a time

  • Flexibility for shift and weekend work

Nice-to-have:

  • Local knowledge of Munich and surrounding areas and experience driving in the city

  • Experience with tools, mechanics or hands-on repairs

  • Comfortable using digital tools and apps

  • A calm head in stressful moments, like tricky parking or traffic

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway — we'll teach you the rest.

Good to know:

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of extension.

Why Voi?

We're Europe's leading micromobility company and one of the fastest-growing scale-ups around. You'll work alongside a diverse, motivated team and have a direct hand in making Hamburg cleaner, quieter and better to live in.

Ready for your Voiage? Apply now.

title: Frukostvärd till Steam Hotel - Helgjobb
description:
Frukostvärd till vår fantastiska frukost på Steam Hotel

Ångan stiger inne på Steam Hotel*, om vägarna kunde tala finns det historier från 100 år tillbaka. Att kliva in under den enorma kristallkronan, ta sig upp till översta våningen för asiatiska smaker och blicka ut över Mälaren – det är verkligen en helt magisk känsla.*

På Steam är det inte en tråkig sekund – stora banketter, nykära par, underhållning och så mycket mer!

Upplevelser i världsklass, minnen för livet och en arbetsplats att vara riktigt stolt över.

Vi lever våra värdeord i allt vi gör. Att vara Passionerad, Professionell, Lekfull & Personlig är vad som gör oss unika och vad som får oss att växa.

Just nu söker vi en ny stjärna till vårt frukostteam.

Passar dig som är morgonpigg och söker ett socialt extrajobb vid sidan av studier eller annat arbete.

Om rollen som Frukostvärd:

Som person är du positiv, lyhörd och engagerad i gästernas behov och önskemål. Du har glimten i ögat, en ödmjuk framtoning och en stor vilja att vara med och utveckla. Vidare är du ordningsam, ansvarsfull och har detaljfokus. Du är prestigelös och rycker in där det behövs.

Om tjänsten

Som Frukostvärd hos oss startar du dagen i vår frukostrestaurang. Arbetsuppgifterna är varierande, och du kommer att få göra allt från att fylla på kaffe/juice på våra dryckesstationer till att servera och plocka disk. Den viktigaste delen av jobbet är att prata med våra gäster och få dem att känna sig som hemma. Precis lika viktigt är samspelet med dina medarbetare – din sociala kompetens kommer att vara A och O! Vi kommer att anställa dig som sticker ut och vågar vara personlig. Dig som gästerna kommer ihåg och vill träffa igen.

En servicemänniska ut i fingerspetsarna som älskar att skapa unika gästupplevelser. Du är en positiv och initiativrik person som trivs med att jobba i en händelserik miljö och ha många bollar i luften samtidigt. Med din lekfullhet skapar du en härlig stämning, och med din professionalism ser du varje enskild gäst och tar hand om dem på ett sådant sätt att de alltid vill komma tillbaka. Du har spring i benen, men stannar också upp och ser detaljer och möjligheter till förbättring. För att passa hos oss är det viktigt att du inte är blyg. Du ska vilja lära känna gästerna och ge dem det lilla extra som man inte räknar med.

Utöver det tror vi att du behöver:

  • Ett härligt morgonhumör.

  • Intresse för människor och merförsäljning.

  • Tidigare erfarenhet av att jobba i service.

  • Ha snabba fötter och gilla när det händer mycket.

  • Vara lugn och lösningsorienterad även i stressade situationer.

  • Ta ansvar och våga axla upp när det behövs.

  • Ha en positiv attityd och sprida energi omkring dig.

Frukostvärd: 10–15 % varannan helg (lördag & söndag, ca 4 h/dag) Arbetstider: Varierande, inklusive tidiga morgnar och helger Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse Lön: Enligt avtal

Om processen:

Vi kommer att kalla till intervjuer löpande. Sista ansökningsdag är 7 sep.

Hos oss får du en arbetsplats med utvecklingsmöjligheter, både inom huset och inom ESS Group. Vi jobbar ständigt med att utbilda våra medarbetare med hjälp av interna utbildningar inom ledarskap, stresshantering och mycket mer. Som medarbetare hos oss får du tillgång till extremt fina rabatter på våra destinationer och restauranger runt om i Norden. Vi ställer dessutom till med festligheter och andra roliga aktiviteter för att hålla samman teamet. Utöver det får du en säker anställning och friskvårdsbidrag. Samt otroliga kollegor och kanske till och med vänner för livet!

Är du redo att ta ansvaret för att skapa oförglömliga morgonupplevelser för våra gäster? Välkommen med din ansökan till Steam Hotel – ett steg närmare ditt nya drömjobb.

title: 1st Pressman - Web Press
description:
At sg360°, we partner with Fortune 1000 brands to deliver direct marketing campaigns that drive measurable results. Our production teams are the driving force behind delivering high-quality direct marketing solutions for some of the nation’s leading brands. Working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, our employees operate specialized printing, finishing, and mailing equipment while maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, teamwork, and efficiency. Every role on the production floor plays a vital part in producing and distributing millions of marketing pieces that help our clients connect with their customers and achieve their business objectives.

What we offer

  • Competitive union wages: $42.00 - $47.00 per hour
  • Comprehensive union benefits package, Health, Dental and Vision
  • Pension & Profit Sharing
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Life Insurance
  • Short-term disability
  • Wellness resources
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Overtime opportunities


Job Summary
The 1st Web Pressman leads the operation of a web press and provides direction to the press crew during setup, production, maintenance, and changeovers. This role is responsible for producing high-quality printed products while ensuring safety, efficiency, and adherence to production schedules.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and direct the press crew through setup, operation, and job changeovers.
  • Review job tickets and determine effective production methods.
  • Ensure products meet customer specifications and quality standards.
  • Monitor registration, color, folds, glue patterns, die cuts, perforations, and other print characteristics.
  • Coordinate shift handoffs and communicate equipment status.
  • Oversee routine maintenance and housekeeping.
  • Troubleshoot web breaks and production challenges.
  • Collaborate with maintenance on repairs.
  • Train and mentor crew members.
  • Ensure safety procedures and PPE compliance.
  • Monitor production counts and quality checkpoints.
  • Support continuous improvement.

title: Stationsvärdar till Stockholm Centralstation!
description:
V söker vi stationsvärdar där du kommer vara placerad på Stockholm Centralstation och arbeta med att bidra till en trygg och säker miljö för resenärer. Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag!

Om tjänsten

Som stationsvärd kommer du arbeta på tågstationen och ansvara för att informera och hjälpa resenärerna. Arbetet är uppdelat på två pass per dag och är 3 timmar vardera och vi har ett krav på att vara tillgänglig för minst 3 pass/vecka.

Arbetstider är enligt nedan: Vardagar och helger 06:00-09:00 & 15:00-18:00

Gör du bra ifrån dig på detta uppdrag finns även möjligheter till värdefulla referenser och karriärsmöjligheter, en resa flera konsulter gjort hos oss tidigare.

Du erbjuds

  • Ett flexibelt arbete med mycket social kontakt!
  • Goda möjligheter till värdefulla referenser och framtida karriärsmöjligheter! Som konsult för Academic Work erbjuder vi stora möjligheter för dig att växa professionellt, bygga ditt nätverk och skapa värdefulla kontakter för framtiden. Läs mer om vårt konsulterbjudande.

Arbetsuppgifter

Denna roll handlar om att vara en central punkt för service och support, där du aktivt bidrar till en positiv och effektiv miljö för besökare och kollegor.

  • Välkomna och guida resenärer
  • Informera vid trafikstörningar och andra händelser som påverkar resenärerna. Att arbetar proaktivt genom att erbjuda resenärerna hjälp
  • Säkerställa en trygg miljö genom god kommunikation med resenärer
  • Assistera med praktiska arrangemang

Vi söker dig som

  • Har en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning på minst 50%, t ex studier eller annat arbete i minst 1 år framöver
  • Har tidigare erfarenhet av ett serviceinriktat arbete
  • Talar obehindrad svenska då du kommer att besvara frågor från resenärer
  • Har möjlighet att arbeta minst 3 pass i veckan
  • Har en smartphone som du kan använda i tjänsten då en del av arbetet sker ifrån en mobilapplikaiton

Övrig information

  • Start: Omgående
  • Omfattning: Deltid, antal timmar varierar beroende på hur många pass du väljer att boka in dig på men vi ser att du ska vara tillgänglig för minst 3 pass/vecka

För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper: Vi söker dig som är social och serviceinriktad. Du är inte rädd för att ta kontakt med resenärer och vet hur man levererar en service av världsklass. Vidare är du flexibel, ansvarstagande och har en förmåga att se när resenärer behöver hjälp och tar initiativ till att lösa problem.

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

title: Junior HIL Rig Developer
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will help build and maintain virtual HiL testing environments used to verify engines and driveline systems before physical testing in rig or field environments. The role combines software development, simulation, automation, and systems engineering, with a clear goal: making testing smarter, more efficient, and increasingly automated.

You will work in a collaborative engineering setting where you move between software, hardware, and system-level thinking. This is a strong opportunity if you want to grow in virtual testing, integration, and modern development methods while solving real technical challenges.

Job Description
  • You contribute to robust and creative technical solutions for complex engineering challenges.
  • You develop and adapt simulation models and signal handling for virtual test environments.
  • You improve workflows, tools, and test environments to support verification, validation, and pre-testing.
  • You integrate virtual rigs, test tools, and ECU systems.
  • You troubleshoot technical issues and support day-to-day operation when needed.
  • You provide rig support to users and help colleagues make effective use of the virtual testing environment.
  • You work closely with stakeholders to turn needs into practical, reliable solutions.
Requirements
  • Experience in development within technical, automotive, engine, or test-related environments.
  • Good understanding of test automation, system integration, or model-based development.
  • Experience with one or more of the following: Python, LabVIEW, VeriStand, Git, Jenkins, MATLAB/Simulink.
  • Interest in HiL systems, ECUs, CAN communication, and real-time systems.
  • Ability to work in a structured way and manage several tasks in parallel.
  • Good communication skills in English.
  • A service-minded and collaborative approach, with a genuine interest in supporting users.
  • Ability to complete required background checks before start.
Nice to have
  • Experience from engine, vehicle, or testing environments.
  • Knowledge of model development, simulation, or real-time systems.
  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, and version control.
  • Understanding of calibration, verification, and validation.
  • Strong competence in electrical engineering, signal conversion, mechatronics, or embedded systems.
  • Experience working with sensor and actuator signals, communication interfaces, or signal conditioning.
  • Familiarity with AI-based tools or methods used to support development, testing, or automation.
  • Experience working closely with users and translating needs into functional technical solutions.
What We Offer
  • Permanent employment at Avaron AB
  • Occupational pension
  • Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year
Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Lapiomies kaapelinkaivuuseen – Turku / Aloitus heti!
description:

  • Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja valmiutta ulkotyöhön

Good Staff Henkilöstöpalvelut - Good stuff with the Good Staff

title: Kantpressare
description:

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
About Acron Aviation (Avionics – Surveillance):
Acron Aviation designs, engineers, and manufactures certified avionics systems that support safety-critical flight operations across commercial and military aviation. Within Avionics, the Surveillance product line develops and sustains systems that enable aircraft awareness, collision avoidance, and airspace interoperability. Our portfolio includes TCAS, Mode S transponders, ADS-B, and integrated surveillance solutions deployed across commercial, military, and rotorcraft platforms. This work is performed in highly regulated environments and demands deep expertise across systems, hardware, software, and RF throughout the full product lifecycle.

Job Title
Senior Specialist, Test Engineer

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will play a key role in developing and implementing automated test systems used for manufacturing, engineering development, and product certification of safety-critical avionics products. You will lead test system projects from concept through deployment, ensuring solutions are delivered on time, within budget, and meet quality and performance expectations.

This role offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge avionics technologies while collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams in a highly regulated aerospace environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop requirements, architectures, and designs for automated test stations.
  • Design, develop, document, and maintain test software solutions.
  • Lead test system development projects with minimal supervision.
  • Conduct peer reviews of software and requirements documentation.
  • Execute software verification and validation activities.
  • Perform systems-level integration and testing of automated test stations.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans, procedures, and reports.
  • Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis of hardware and software issues.
  • Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to improve product reliability and test efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace and company standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 6+ years of related experience programming in C.
  • 4+ years of experience in product testing, automated test systems, or related engineering functions.
  • Experience working with digital electronic circuits.
  • Knowledge of:
  • NI TestStand
  • LabWindows/CVI
  • IEEE-488 (GPIB) controllers and drivers
  • Environmental test equipment and temperature chambers
  • Experience with avionics communication protocols, including:
  • ARINC 429
  • ARINC 717
  • MIL-STD-1553
  • I2C
  • RS-232
  • RS-422
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with L-band high-power pulsed transmitters and receivers.
  • Experience with RF test equipment and automated RF test systems.
  • Demonstrated expertise debugging and optimizing complex C software applications.
  • Aerospace, avionics, or safety-critical systems experience.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
  • Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
Equal Opportunity Statement
Acron Aviation is proud to be an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to treating all employees and applicants with respect and dignity and to maintaining a workplace free from unlawful discrimination. All applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or other related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Acron Aviation maintains a drug-free workplace and conducts pre-employment substance abuse testing and background checks, where allowed by law. Acron Aviation is an E-Verify employer

title: Technical Project Manager (f/m/d)
description:
The TPM leads enterprise software and SaaS implementation projects from kickoff through go-live, handover, and early value realization. TPM role is the primary delivery partner for customers and the central coordinator across internal teams. It combines delivery discipline, technical fluency, commercial stewardship, and customer outcome ownership.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end project lifecycle: scope, plan, governance, execution, go-live, handover, and retrospective.
  • Translate Statements of Work, contracts, and customer requirements into clear milestones, deliverables, dependencies, resourcing, and decision paths.
  • Lead cross-functional delivery teams spanning Solution Development, Cloud Enablement, Support & Operations, Product, Finance, Customer Success, and partners.
  • Serve as the primary delivery contact for customer stakeholders; lead project reviews, steering committees, and executive updates as required.
  • Define success criteria and adoption milestones; identify customer risks early and ensure a seamless transition to ongoing Customer Success and Operations.
  • Facilitate requirements and solution workshops; coordinate integrations, configuration, data migration, testing, deployment, and technical dependencies.
  • Maintain project plans, RAID logs, decisions, actions, status reports, and delivery documentation in the agreed systems.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in technical project management, customer success and in the technical configuration or deployment of complex software solutions, ideally in a SaaS or digital project environment
  • Proven experience delivering complex customer-facing implementation projects, including planning, stakeholder management, reporting, risk management, and change control.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS, Cloud, CMS, DAM, PIM, MRM, MarTech, or comparable platforms; working knowledge of Agile and/or Waterfall delivery.
  • Familiarity with interfaces and data-driven systems - e.g. through APIs, data imports or workflow design
  • Ability to translate business needs into functional and technical requirements and lead discussions with architects, developers, consultants, and Cloud teams.
  • Familiarity with integrations, APIs, data migration, configuration, and enterprise architecture. Knowledge of XML, XSLT, Node-RED, or Java is advantageous.
  • Strong customer communication, executive presentation, negotiation, commercial awareness, and conflict-resolution skills.

Benefits

Why us?

Because we have a lot to offer!
  • We offer an individual, annual training budget of 1.000,- €/$/CHF/£ to support your professional development and personal growth.
  • We give you the opportunity to learn up to 14 languages through a professional Babbel account.
  • We encourage flexible working hours and hybrid working solutions.
  • We offer comprehensive health benefits with 50% covered by the company.
  • We believe in a connected world: get inspired by working remotely up to 60 days per year, from anywhere you like.
  • We support our local or global communities under our motto #censharingiscaring
  • We are aware of our responsibility, therefore sustainability plays a big role in our everyday life.
  • We love to celebrate! Our events are just a blast and will be even better with you.
  • We celebrate your special events – for example birthday and work anniversaries.
  • We collaborate with highly motivated, competent colleagues from more than 30 different countries.

title: Cycle Counter
location: PJ Ohio Mfg Facility - Mt Orab, OH 45154
description:
Job Overview

A successful Warehouse Cycle Counter is responsible for monitoring warehouse inventory and performing cycle counting duties to ensure that all materials are properly verified and are reflective of reported inventory. The Cycle Counter will maintain inventory accuracy through proper counting, processing of material reports and transfers.

Job Responsibilities

  • Actively observe and promote ATW safety standards
  • Work directly with the purchasing team, shipping and receiving team, and production team to resolve inventory shortages, inaccurate counts, theft, defects.
  • Establish a cycle count schedule using and ABC classification, determine inventory grouping, and a count frequency.
  • Conduct daily cycle counts of finished goods and raw materials.
  • Track all counts and review results daily with supervisor.
  • Maintain a detailed record for all inventory count activities.
  • Lead and perform root-cause analysis when count variances are identified.
  • Identify and correct inventory issues and discrepancies.
  • Audit supplier deliveries, and the overall receiving process.
  • Assist during monthly inventory audits.
  • Other duties, as assigned by supervisor.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

  • Must be capable of standing for entire shift and sit for extended periods of time.
  • Able to lift-up to 50 lbs.; ability to demonstrate full range of motion for reaching, bending, kneeling, and stooping.
  • Will be exposed to extreme heat and cold depending on weather.
  • Subject to dirt, dust, oil, welding fumes, traffic hazards, and high noise levels in the workplace

title: Founder's Office Ops (Working Student)
description:
Mello is building the AI-native control platform for complex enterprise spend.

Enterprises spend trillions on their supply chains and almost none of it is actually controlled. Contracts run hundreds of pages, invoices run hundreds of line items, and no system on the market can check the one against the other. So invoices get paid without anyone really looking, and 5 to 10% of that spend quietly leaks away.

Our AI agents read the invoices, enforce the contracts line by line, dispute what is wrong with the provider, and push clean cost data back into the systems finance already uses. We start with supply chain because it is the largest and most broken of these spend categories, and we grow across the rest as our customers pull us there.

Today we work with retailers, 3PLs and distributors across Europe.

We are venture-backed, still small, and you will see the whole company from the inside.

Aufgaben

You work at the intersection of the Founder's Associate, the founder, and the tech team. Two things sit at the centre: you help build out our product from the commercial side and you support the day-to-day operations.

Because you know the processes from practice, you are the first to see where things break and what keeps repeating. That is where the next features of the platform come from.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Product from the commercial side: You translate process knowledge into requirements, define edge cases, test new features, and prioritise with the team. You won't write the code, but you will shape what gets built.
  • Operations: You take on operational work in the day-to-day business and run it reliably and cleanly.
  • Collect feedback and pass it on: You actively gather feedback from customers and from daily operations, structure it, and hand it to the tech team so it turns into the next version.
  • Commercial support: You help us find the right target customers. Sharpening the ICP, researching accounts and decision makers, enriching and preparing lists, and keeping the CRM clean so the sales team can move straight into a relevant conversation.

Qualifikation

Mindset

  • You take full ownership and pride in execution
  • You want to see how processes in a startup are actually built, because you intend to build them yourself one day in your own company
  • You want to learn product development from the non-technical side, from requirement to release
  • You enjoy bringing structure to messy, open-ended problems and have an eye for when something should stop being manual

Experience

  • Ideally first experience in operations, an early-stage startup, consulting, or another high-agency environment, e.g. as an intern or working student. However, what counts most is motivation and drive
  • Comfortable with data and tools, ideally some exposure to automation (Claude, Lovable, Make, n8n, or similar) — or a strong drive to go deep on them fast
  • Fluent German is a must. Most customer and provider communication runs in German. Good English for everything internal
  • Enrolled at university, 20 hrs / week, based in Berlin

Benefits

  • Ownership of your own topics, including the operational work that comes with them
  • Close collaboration with the founder, the founder's associate, and the tech team
  • Attractive compensation
  • An environment where you see and shape how a process becomes a product. Good training if you want to build something in tech yourself one day
  1. Application review → every application is reviewed by the team
  2. Intro call → 30 minutes with the Founder's Associate
  3. Founders call → 30 minutes with the founder
  4. Offer → clear decision and fast feedback

title: Upphandlingskonsult till Regioninköp
description:
Vi söker en upphandlare till upphandlingsenheten, som är en del av Regioninköp. Regioninköp har uppdraget att strategiskt och operativt, samordna, kvalitetssäkra och utveckla inköps- och e-handelsprocessen inom regionen.

Din arbetsplats

Region Värmland arbetar med kategoristyrt inköp vilket är en strategiskt processbaserad metod. Regioninköp består av 29 personer, varav 15 som jobbar inom upphandlingsenheten. Vi är ett härligt gäng som stöttar varandra och har roligt på jobbet. Vi ingår i planerings- och ekonomiavdelningen, som har en betydande roll i arbetet att skapa balans i ekonomin och är ansvariga för ekonomi, verksamhetsuppföljning och inköp för Region Värmland.

Regioninköp genomför upphandlingar till samtliga verksamheter inom Region Värmland. Några exempel på områden som vi upphandlar inom är IT och kommunikation, kultur, fastighet, vård- och tandvårdsrelaterade utrustningar, förbrukningsvaror och tjänster, läkemedel med tillhörande tjänster.

Hos oss får du ett meningsfullt arbete där du har möjlighet att bidra till en effektiv användning av våra resurser och skapa bästa möjliga värde för både skattemedel och verksamheter.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Du kommer främst att arbeta med IT-relaterade upphandlingar, samt vara ett stöd med juridiska interna frågeställningar. Vi har många juridiska frågeställningar i det dagliga arbetet och ditt stöd kommer att vara viktigt för enhetens utveckling. Regionen har regionjurister som har ansvaret för överprövningar bland annat.

Som upphandlare hos oss har du en sammanhållen projektledarroll och du kommer främst att leda och driva upphandlingsprojekt i samarbete med verksamheterna, samt ge råd och stöd inom upphandling och upphandlingsjuridik. Upphandlingsarbetet på Region Värmland genomförs i projektform där ansvarig upphandlare självständigt driver arbetet.

Du samarbetar med upphandlarna på enheten i upphandlingsarbetet och med övriga medarbetare på regionen inom upphandlingsfrågor. Arbetet innebär många kontakter inom Region Värmland.

Dina kunskaper och kompetenser

Vi söker dig som har:

  • akademisk utbildning inom juridik, eller annat relevant område
  • god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska
  • grundläggande förståelse av IT, exempelvis system, tjänster eller tekniska miljöer

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Optinova is more than a manufacturer of tubing – we are experts in advanced extrusion and material technologies. Our products are used where quality and precision are critical: IV catheters, infusion sets, small catheter systems, as well as components for coffee machines and aerospace technology.

Our global headquarters is located in Åland, Finland. We operate production facilities across three continents and have sales offices worldwide. We develop solutions together with our customer with a strong focus on innovation, quality, and reliability, we create the solutions of tomorrow.

Optinova is embarking on an exciting digital transformation journey, strengthening how we use data, technology, and AI to improve our operations and create business value.

We are looking for Data Platform Engineers to join our Digital Value Services function. You will contribute to the development of data platforms, digital services, and applications that support business processes, analytics, automation, and future AI capabilities.

This is a broad engineering role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of business and technology. The role offers opportunities to develop toward areas such as AI engineering and forward-deployed engineering. What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, integrations, data products, and platform capabilities.
  • Collaborate with business-stream process owners and stakeholders to productize business challenges into scalable and reliable digital services and products.
  • Develop domain-driven data products based on data mesh principles, supporting clear ownership, reusability, interoperability, and trusted access to data.
  • Deliver solutions iteratively using an agile mindset, incorporating feedback and adapting to evolving business needs and priorities.
  • Apply modern engineering practices, including DevOps and DataOps, while supporting quality, security, governance, documentation, and compliance throughout the solution lifecycle.
  • Explore how data, AI, and automation can solve business problems and create measurable value.

What We’re Looking For

You have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, data science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field. Equivalent knowledge gained through practical experience is also relevant.

You have experience or a strong foundation in some of the following areas:

  • SQL, Python, or similar programming languages
  • Data & AI pipelines, integrations, APIs, and automation
  • Cloud data platforms, data modelling, and data products
  • Software development and deployment practices

Experience with Azure, Databricks, Power BI, or similar technologies is beneficial, but we do not expect you to be an expert in every area.

You are also:

  • Able to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders, clarify requirements, and communicate solutions clearly.
  • Collaborative, curious, and motivated by solving real business problems.
  • Comfortable taking ownership and delivering iteratively as needs and priorities evolve.
  • Fluent in English. Swedish or other relevant language skills are considered an advantage.

Experience in manufacturing, ERP systems, regulated industries, AI, machine learning, or business-facing technical delivery is considered beneficial.

Why Join Us?

  • Play an active role in Optinova’s digital transformation journey.
  • Work across data platforms, digital services, applications, automation, analytics, and AI.
  • Develop toward different technical career paths based on your capabilities and interests.
  • Join a culture that values collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and employee wellbeing.

Location

The role can be based at our headquarters in Mariehamn, Åland, or at our office in Uppsala, Sweden.

Compensation:

The salary range (3800-5000€ or 40,000 - 50,000 SEK) has been established based on the role's requirements and current market conditions. Placement within the range is determined by relevant experience, skills, and qualifications. If a candidate brings substantial additional experience, specialist expertise, or qualifications that exceed the requirements, compensation above the stated range may be considered.

We welcome your application!

Please note: We do not accept applications via email. Applications must be submitted through the application link only.

Please answer the questions in the application form and submit your CV. The deadline for applications is 15.09.2026 but we may begin interviewing during the application period. Please share a link to your GitHub profile, portfolio, or other examples of your technical work. Candidates progressing to the second interview stage will be asked to share and demonstrate their technical and programming capabilities.

For questions about the position, please contact People&Culture Business Partner Nadia Elamidi nadia.elamidi@optinova.com

If you are not a citizen of an EU/EEA country or Switzerland, you will need to present a valid work and residence permit at a potential interview.

Optinova is more than a tubing manufacturer — we are experts in advanced extrusion and material technologies. Our products are used in applications where quality and precision are critical. Our global headquarters is located in Åland, Finland. We operate production across three continents and have sales offices worldwide. By developing solutions together with our customers, with a strong focus on innovation, quality, and reliability, we create the solutions of tomorrow.
